    51→
    52→def _epic_sort_key(epic_data: dict) -> int:
    53→    return int(epic_data.get("dependency_order", 999))
    54→
    55→
    56→def _normalized_epic_name(raw_name: str) -> str:
    57→    return raw_name if raw_name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX) else f"{EPIC_PREFIX}{raw_name}"
    58→
    59→
    60→def _update_existing_epic_cluster(
    61→    existing: Cluster,
    62→    epic_data: dict,
    63→    *,
    64→    now: str,
    65→    version: int,
    66→) -> None:
    67→    existing["thesis"] = epic_data["thesis"]
    68→    existing["direction"] = epic_data["direction"]
    69→    existing["root_cause"] = epic_data.get("root_cause", "")
    70→    existing["issue_ids"] = epic_data["issue_ids"]
    71→    existing["dismissed"] = epic_data.get("dismissed", [])
    72→    existing["agent_safe"] = epic_data.get("agent_safe", False)
    73→    existing["dependency_order"] = epic_data["dependency_order"]
    74→    existing["action_steps"] = epic_data.get("action_steps", [])
    75→    existing["execution_status"] = EXECUTION_STATUS_ACTIVE
    76→    existing["updated_at"] = now
    77→    existing["triage_version"] = version
    78→    existing["description"] = epic_data["thesis"]
    79→    # Don't overwrite in_progress status from agent
    80→    if existing.get("status") != "in_progress":
    81→        existing["status"] = epic_data.get("status", "pending")
    82→
    83→
    84→def _create_epic_cluster(
    85→    *,
    86→    epic_name: str,
    87→    epic_data: dict,
    88→    now: str,
    89→    version: int,
    90→) -> Cluster:
    91→    return {
    92→        "name": epic_name,
    93→        "description": epic_data["thesis"],
    94→        "issue_ids": epic_data["issue_ids"],
    95→        "auto": True,
    96→        "cluster_key": f"epic::{epic_name}",
    97→        "action": f"desloppify plan focus {epic_name}",
    98→        "execution_status": EXECUTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
    99→        "user_modified": False,
   100→        "created_at": now,
   101→        "updated_at": now,
   102→        # Epic fields
   103→        "thesis": epic_data["thesis"],
   104→        "direction": epic_data["direction"],
   105→        "root_cause": epic_data.get("root_cause", ""),
   106→        "supersedes": [],
   107→        "dismissed": epic_data.get("dismissed", []),
   108→        "agent_safe": epic_data.get("agent_safe", False),
   109→        "dependency_order": epic_data["dependency_order"],
   110→        "action_steps": epic_data.get("action_steps", []),
   111→        "source_clusters": [],
   112→        "status": epic_data.get("status", "pending"),
   113→        "triage_version": version,
   114→    }
   115→
   116→
   117→def _upsert_triage_clusters(
   118→    *,
   119→    clusters: dict[str, Cluster],
   120→    triage: TriageResult,
   121→    now: str,
   122→    version: int,
   123→) -> tuple[int, int]:
   124→    created = 0
   125→    updated = 0
   126→    for epic_data in sorted(triage.clusters, key=_epic_sort_key):
   127→        raw_name = epic_data["name"]
   128→        epic_name = _normalized_epic_name(raw_name)
   129→        existing = clusters.get(epic_name)
   130→        if existing and existing.get("thesis"):
   131→            _update_existing_epic_cluster(existing, epic_data, now=now, version=version)
   132→            updated += 1
   133→            continue
   134→        clusters[epic_name] = _create_epic_cluster(
   135→            epic_name=epic_name,
   136→            epic_data=epic_data,
   137→            now=now,
   138→            version=version,
   139→        )
   140→        created += 1
   141→    return created, updated
   142→
   143→
   144→def _reorder_queue_by_dependency(
   145→    *,
   146→    order: list[str],
   147→    triage: TriageResult,
   148→    dismissed_ids: list[str],
   149→) -> None:
   150→    epic_issue_ids: set[str] = set()
   151→    epic_ordered_ids: list[str] = []
   152→    dismissed_set = set(dismissed_ids)
   153→    for epic_data in sorted(triage.clusters, key=_epic_sort_key):
   154→        for fid in epic_data["issue_ids"]:
   155→            if fid in epic_issue_ids or fid in dismissed_set:
   156→                continue
   157→            epic_issue_ids.add(fid)
   158→            epic_ordered_ids.append(fid)
   159→
   160→    non_epic_items = [fid for fid in order if fid not in epic_issue_ids]
   161→    order.clear()
   162→    order.extend(epic_ordered_ids)
   163→    order.extend(non_epic_items)
   164→
   165→
   166→def _set_triage_meta(
   167→    *,
   168→    plan: PlanModel,
   169→    state: StateModel,
   170→    triage: TriageResult,
   171→    now: str,
   172→    version: int,
   173→    dismissed_ids: list[str],
   174→    trigger: str,
   175→) -> None:
   176→    current_hash = review_issue_snapshot_hash(state)
   177→    open_review_ids = sorted(
   178→        fid
   179→        for fid, issue in (state.get("work_items") or state.get("issues", {})).items()
   180→        if issue.get("status") == "open"
   181→        and is_triage_finding(issue)
   182→    )
   183→
   184→    plan["epic_triage_meta"] = {
   185→        "triaged_ids": open_review_ids,
   186→        "last_run": now,
   187→        "version": version,
   188→        "dismissed_ids": dismissed_ids,
   189→        "issue_snapshot_hash": current_hash,
   190→        "strategy_summary": triage.strategy_summary,
   191→        "trigger": trigger,
   192→    }
   193→
   194→
   195→def _apply_auto_cluster_decisions(
   196→    *,
   197→    plan: PlanModel,
   198→    decisions: list[AutoClusterDecision],
   199→    order: list[str],
   200→    now: str,
   201→    version: int,
   202→    result: TriageMutationResult,
   203→) -> None:
   204→    """Process auto_cluster_decisions from the triage result.
   205→
   206→    - promote: add cluster issue IDs to queue_order
   207→    - skip: mark the cluster as skipped in the plan
   208→    - break_up: record the decision for downstream processing
   209→    """
   210→    clusters = plan["clusters"]
   211→
   212→    for decision in decisions:
   213→        cluster_name = decision.cluster
   214→        cluster = clusters.get(cluster_name)
   215→        if cluster is None:
   216→            continue
   217→
   218→        action = decision.action
   219→
   220→        if action == "promote":
   221→            issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   222→            existing_in_order = set(order)
   223→            new_ids = [
   224→                fid for fid in issue_ids
   225→                if isinstance(fid, str) and fid not in existing_in_order
   226→            ]
   227→            # Determine insertion position based on priority hint
   228→            priority = (decision.priority or "").lower().strip()
   229→            if priority == "first":
   230→                for i, fid in enumerate(new_ids):
   231→                    order.insert(i, fid)
   232→            elif priority.startswith("after "):
   233→                target = priority[len("after "):]
   234→                insert_idx = len(order)
   235→                for idx, item in enumerate(order):
   236→                    if target in item:
   237→                        insert_idx = idx + 1
   238→                        break
   239→                for i, fid in enumerate(new_ids):
   240→                    order.insert(insert_idx + i, fid)
   241→            elif priority.startswith("before "):
   242→                target = priority[len("before "):]
   243→                insert_idx = len(order)
   244→                for idx, item in enumerate(order):
   245→                    if target in item:
   246→                        insert_idx = idx
   247→                        break
   248→                for i, fid in enumerate(new_ids):
   249→                    order.insert(insert_idx + i, fid)
   250→            else:
   251→                # "last" or unrecognized: append to end
   252→                order.extend(new_ids)
   253→
   254→            cluster["execution_status"] = EXECUTION_STATUS_ACTIVE
   255→            cluster["updated_at"] = now
   256→            cluster["triage_version"] = version
   257→            result.auto_clusters_promoted += 1
   258→
   259→        elif action == "skip":
   260→            cluster["triage_skip"] = {
   261→                "reason": decision.reason,
   262→                "skipped_at": now,
   263→                "triage_version": version,
   264→            }
   265→            cluster["updated_at"] = now
   266→            result.auto_clusters_skipped += 1
   267→
   268→        elif action == "break_up":
   269→            cluster["triage_break_up"] = {
   270→                "reason": decision.reason,
   271→                "sub_clusters": decision.sub_clusters,
   272→                "decided_at": now,
   273→                "triage_version": version,
   274→            }
   275→            cluster["updated_at"] = now
   276→            result.auto_clusters_broken_up += 1
   277→
   278→
   279→def apply_triage_to_plan(
   280→    plan: PlanModel,
   281→    state: StateModel,
   282→    triage: TriageResult,
   283→    *,
   284→    trigger: str = "manual",
   285→) -> TriageMutationResult:
   286→    """Apply parsed triage result to the living plan.
   287→
   288→    1. Creates/updates triage clusters in plan["clusters"]
   289→    2. Marks dismissed issues as triaged_out skips
   290→    3. Reorders queue_order to group cluster members by dependency_order
   291→    4. Updates epic_triage_meta with snapshot hash
   292→    """
   293→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   294→    ensure_state_defaults(state)
   295→    now = utc_now()
   296→    result = TriageMutationResult()
   297→    result.strategy_summary = triage.strategy_summary
   298→
   299→    clusters = plan["clusters"]
   300→    skipped: dict = plan["skipped"]
   301→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   302→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   303→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   304→    result.triage_version = version
   305→
   306→    created, updated = _upsert_triage_clusters(
   307→        clusters=clusters,
   308→        triage=triage,
   309→        now=now,
   310→        version=version,
   311→    )
   312→    result.epics_created += created
   313→    result.epics_updated += updated
   314→
   315→    dismissed_ids, dismiss_count = dismiss_triage_issues(
   316→        triage=triage,
   317→        order=order,
   318→        skipped=skipped,
   319→        now=now,
   320→        version=version,
   321→        scan_count=int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   322→    )
   323→    result.issues_dismissed += dismiss_count
   324→
   325→    # Sync state status for dismissed issues so state is authoritative.
   326→    issues = (state.get("work_items") or state.get("issues", {}))
   327→    triaged_out_status = skip_kind_state_status("triaged_out")
   328→    for fid in dismissed_ids:
   329→        issue = issues.get(fid)
   330→        if issue and issue.get("status") == "open" and triaged_out_status:
   331→            issue["status"] = triaged_out_status
   332→            issue["note"] = f"Triaged out by epic triage v{version}"
   333→
   334→    _reorder_queue_by_dependency(
   335→        order=order,
   336→        triage=triage,
   337→        dismissed_ids=dismissed_ids,
   338→    )
   339→
   340→    # Process auto-cluster decisions (backward-compatible: no-op if empty)
   341→    if triage.auto_cluster_decisions:
   342→        _apply_auto_cluster_decisions(
   343→            plan=plan,
   344→            decisions=triage.auto_cluster_decisions,
   345→            order=order,
   346→            now=now,
   347→            version=version,
   348→            result=result,
   349→        )
   350→
   351→    _set_triage_meta(
   352→        plan=plan,
   353→        state=state,
   354→        triage=triage,
   355→        now=now,
   356→        version=version,
   357→        dismissed_ids=dismissed_ids,
   358→        trigger=trigger,
   359→    )
   360→    plan["updated"] = now
   361→
   362→    return result
   363→
   364→__all__ = ["TriageMutationResult", "apply_triage_to_plan"]
   365→

   329→    issue_ids: set[str],
   330→    issues: dict[str, dict] | None = None,
   331→) -> None:
   332→    if not issue_ids:
   333→        return
   334→    parts.append(f"## {title} ({len(issue_ids)})")
   335→    for issue_id in sorted(issue_ids):
   336→        if issues is None:
   337→            parts.append(f"- {issue_id}")
   338→            continue
   339→        issue = issues.get(issue_id, {})
   340→        parts.append(f"- {issue_id}: {issue.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   341→    parts.append("")
   342→
   343→
   344→def _append_resolved_issue_context(parts: list[str], resolved_issues: dict[str, dict]) -> None:
   345→    if not resolved_issues:
   346→        return
   347→    parts.append(
   348→        "## Resolved review issues available for recurrence context "
   349→        f"({len(resolved_issues)})"
   350→    )
   351→    resolved_ids = sorted(resolved_issues)
   352→    for issue_id in resolved_ids[:30]:
   353→        issue = resolved_issues.get(issue_id, {})
   354→        summary = str(issue.get("summary", "(no summary)"))
   355→        dimension = _issue_dimension(issue)
   356→        dim_suffix = f" [{dimension}]" if dimension else ""
   357→        parts.append(f"- {issue_id}{dim_suffix}: {summary}")
   358→    if len(resolved_ids) > 30:
   359→        parts.append(f"- ... and {len(resolved_ids) - 30} more resolved issues")
   360→    parts.append("")
   361→
   362→
   363→def _append_completed_clusters_section(parts: list[str], completed_clusters: list[dict]) -> None:
   364→    if not completed_clusters:
   365→        return
   366→    parts.append(
   367→        "## Completed clusters since last triage "
   368→        f"({len(completed_clusters)})"
   369→    )
   370→    completed = sorted(
   371→        completed_clusters,
   372→        key=lambda cluster: str(cluster.get("completed_at", "")),
   373→        reverse=True,
   374→    )
   375→    for cluster in completed[:10]:
   376→        name = str(cluster.get("name", "(unnamed cluster)"))
   377→        thesis = str(cluster.get("thesis") or cluster.get("description") or "")
   378→        completed_at = str(cluster.get("completed_at", ""))
   379→        issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   380→        issue_count = len(issue_ids) if isinstance(issue_ids, list) else 0
   381→        parts.append(
   382→            f"- {name}: {thesis} (issues: {issue_count}, completed_at: {completed_at})"
   383→        )
   384→    if len(completed) > 10:
   385→        parts.append(f"- ... and {len(completed) - 10} more completed clusters")
   386→    parts.append("")
   387→
   388→
   389→def _append_recurring_dimensions_section(
   390→    parts: list[str],
   391→    review_issues: dict[str, dict],
   392→    resolved_issues: dict[str, dict],
   393→) -> None:
   394→    recurring = _recurring_dimensions(review_issues, resolved_issues)
   395→    if not recurring:
   396→        return
   397→    parts.append(
   398→        "## Potential recurring dimensions (resolved issues still have open peers)"
   399→    )
   400→    for dimension, bucket in recurring.items():
   401→        open_count = len(bucket["open"])
   402→        resolved_count = len(bucket["resolved"])
   403→        parts.append(
   404→            f"- {dimension}: {open_count} open / {resolved_count} recently resolved"
   405→        )
   406→    parts.append("")
   407→
   408→
   409→def _append_open_review_issues_section(parts: list[str], review_issues: dict[str, dict]) -> None:
   410→    parts.append(f"## All open review issues ({len(review_issues)})")
   411→    for issue_id, issue in sorted(review_issues.items()):
   412→        detail = issue.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(issue.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   413→        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   414→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   415→        confidence = issue.get("confidence", "medium")
   416→        file_path = issue.get("file", "")
   417→        summary = issue.get("summary", "")
   418→        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {issue_id}")
   419→        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   420→        if dimension:
   421→            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   422→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   423→        if suggestion:
   424→            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   425→    parts.append("")
   426→
   427→
   428→def _append_dimension_scores_section(parts: list[str], dimension_scores: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   429→    if not dimension_scores:
   430→        return
   431→    parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   432→    for name, data in sorted(dimension_scores.items()):
   433→        if not isinstance(data, dict):
   434→            continue
   435→        score = data.get("score", "?")
   436→        strict = data.get("strict", score)
   437→        issues = data.get("failing", 0)
   438→        parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   439→    parts.append("")
   440→
   441→
   442→def _append_mechanical_backlog_section(
   443→    parts: list[str],
   444→    objective_backlog_issues: dict[str, dict],
   445→    auto_clusters: dict[str, dict],
   446→) -> None:
   447→    if not objective_backlog_issues:
   448→        return
   449→
   450→    clustered_ids: set[str] = set()
   451→    for cluster in auto_clusters.values():
   452→        issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   453→        if isinstance(issue_ids, list):
   454→            clustered_ids.update(
   455→                issue_id
   456→                for issue_id in issue_ids
   457→                if isinstance(issue_id, str) and issue_id in objective_backlog_issues
   458→            )
   459→
   460→    unclustered = {
   461→        issue_id: issue
   462→        for issue_id, issue in objective_backlog_issues.items()
   463→        if issue_id not in clustered_ids
   464→    }
   465→    clustered_issue_count = len(clustered_ids)
   466→    auto_cluster_count = sum(
   467→        1 for cluster in auto_clusters.values()
   468→        if any(
   469→            isinstance(issue_id, str) and issue_id in objective_backlog_issues
   470→            for issue_id in cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   471→        )
   472→    )
   473→
   474→    parts.append(
   475→        "## Mechanical backlog "
   476→        f"({len(objective_backlog_issues)} items: {clustered_issue_count} in "
   477→        f"{auto_cluster_count} auto-clusters, {len(unclustered)} unclustered)"
   478→    )
   479→    parts.append(
   480→        "These detector-created items stay in backlog unless you explicitly promote them into the active queue."
   481→    )
   482→    parts.append(
   483→        "You MUST make an explicit decision for each auto-cluster listed below. "
   484→        "Include every auto-cluster in your `auto_cluster_decisions` output with one of: "
   485→        "promote (add to active queue with a priority position), "
   486→        "skip (leave in backlog with a reason), or "
   487→        "break_up (split into smaller sub-clusters with a reason)."
   488→    )
   489→
   490→    rendered_clusters: list[tuple[str, dict, int]] = []
   491→    for name, cluster in auto_clusters.items():
   492→        raw_issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   493→        if not isinstance(raw_issue_ids, list):
   494→            continue
   495→        member_count = sum(
   496→            1 for issue_id in raw_issue_ids
   497→            if isinstance(issue_id, str) and issue_id in objective_backlog_issues
   498→        )
   499→        if member_count <= 0:
   500→            continue
   501→        rendered_clusters.append((name, cluster, member_count))
   502→
   503→    if rendered_clusters:
   504→        parts.append("### Auto-clusters (decision required for each)")
   505→        parts.append(
   506→            "These are pre-grouped detector findings. You must decide for each cluster: "
   507→            "promote (into active queue), skip (with reason), or break_up (into sub-clusters). "
   508→            "Include your decisions in the `auto_cluster_decisions` array in your response."
   509→        )
   510→        rendered_clusters.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[2], item[0]))
   511→        visible_clusters = rendered_clusters[:15]
   512→        for name, cluster, member_count in visible_clusters:
   513→            autofix_hint = _cluster_autofix_hint(cluster)
   514→            hint_suffix = f" [autofix: {autofix_hint}]" if autofix_hint else ""
   515→            summary = _cluster_backlog_summary(name, cluster, member_count)
   516→            parts.append(f"- {name} ({member_count} items){hint_suffix}")
   517→            parts.append(f"  {summary}")
   518→        if len(rendered_clusters) > len(visible_clusters):
   519→            remaining = rendered_clusters[len(visible_clusters):]
   520→            remaining_issues = sum(item[2] for item in remaining)
   521→            parts.append(
   522→                f"- ... and {len(remaining)} more clusters ({remaining_issues} issues)"
   523→            )
   524→
   525→    if unclustered:
   526→        parts.append(
   527→            f"### Unclustered items ({len(unclustered)} items — needs human judgment or isolated findings)"
   528→        )
   529→        parts.append(
   530→            "Promote individually with `desloppify plan promote <issue-id>`, or group related items into a manual cluster."
   531→        )
   532→        sample_ids = sorted(
   533→            unclustered,
   534→            key=lambda issue_id: (
   535→                _confidence_sort_key(unclustered[issue_id]),
   536→                issue_id,
   537→            ),
   538→        )[:10]
   539→        for issue_id in sample_ids:
   540→            issue = unclustered[issue_id]
   541→            confidence = str(issue.get("confidence", "medium"))
   542→            summary = str(issue.get("summary", "(no summary)"))
   543→            parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {issue_id} — {summary}")
   544→        if len(unclustered) > len(sample_ids):
   545→            parts.append(
   546→                f"- ... and {len(unclustered) - len(sample_ids)} more unclustered items"
   547→            )
   548→
   549→    parts.append("Browse full backlog: `desloppify backlog`")
   550→    parts.append("Inspect a cluster: `desloppify plan cluster show auto/<name>`")
   551→    parts.append("Inspect an issue: `desloppify show <issue-id>`")
   552→    parts.append("")
   553→
   554→
   555→def _cluster_autofix_hint(cluster: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
   556→    return cluster_autofix_hint(cluster) or ""
   557→
   558→
   559→def _cluster_backlog_summary(name: str, cluster: dict[str, Any], member_count: int) -> str:
   560→    description = str(cluster.get("description") or "").strip()
   561→    if description:
   562→        return description
   563→    title = name.removeprefix("auto/").replace("-", " ")
   564→    if title:
   565→        return f"Address {member_count} {title} findings"
   566→    return f"Address {member_count} detector findings"
   567→
   568→
   569→def _confidence_sort_key(issue: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
   570→    confidence = str(issue.get("confidence", "medium")).lower()
   571→    order = {"high": 0, "medium": 1, "low": 2}
   572→    return order.get(confidence, 1)
   573→
   574→
   575→def _append_previously_dismissed_section(parts: list[str], dismissed_ids: list[str]) -> None:
   576→    if not dismissed_ids:
   577→        return
   578→    parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(dismissed_ids)})")
   579→    parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   580→    for issue_id in dismissed_ids:
   581→        parts.append(f"- {issue_id}")
   582→    parts.append("")
   583→
   584→
   585→def build_triage_prompt(si: TriageInput) -> str:
   586→    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all issue data."""
   587→    parts: list[str] = []
   588→    _append_existing_clusters_section(parts, si.existing_clusters)
   589→    _append_changed_issue_section(
   590→        parts,
   591→        title="New issues since last triage",
   592→        issue_ids=si.new_since_last,
   593→        issues=si.review_issues,
   594→    )
   595→    _append_changed_issue_section(
   596→        parts,
   597→        title="Resolved since last triage",
   598→        issue_ids=si.resolved_since_last,
   599→    )
   600→    _append_resolved_issue_context(parts, si.resolved_issues)
   601→    _append_completed_clusters_section(parts, si.completed_clusters)
   602→    _append_recurring_dimensions_section(parts, si.review_issues, si.resolved_issues)
   603→    _append_open_review_issues_section(parts, si.review_issues)
   604→    _append_dimension_scores_section(parts, si.dimension_scores)
   605→    _append_mechanical_backlog_section(
   606→        parts,
   607→        si.objective_backlog_issues,
   608→        si.auto_clusters,
   609→    )
   610→    _append_previously_dismissed_section(parts, si.previously_dismissed)
   611→    return "\n".join(parts)
   612→
   613→__all__ = [
   614→    "_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT",
   615→    "AutoClusterDecision",
   616→    "ContradictionNote",
   617→    "DismissedIssue",
   618→    "TriageInput",
   619→    "TriageResult",
   620→    "build_triage_prompt",
   621→    "collect_triage_input",
   622→]
   623→

   121→def _format_assessments_table(assessments: list[dict]) -> str:
   122→    """Format structured observe assessments as a readable table for downstream stages."""
   123→    if not assessments:
   124→        return ""
   125→    lines = ["### Structured Observe Assessments\n"]
   126→    lines.append("| Hash | Verdict | Recommendation |")
   127→    lines.append("|------|---------|----------------|")
   128→    for a in assessments:
   129→        h = a.get("hash", "?")
   130→        v = a.get("verdict", "?")
   131→        r = a.get("recommendation", "")
   132→        # Truncate recommendation for table readability
   133→        if len(r) > 80:
   134→            r = r[:77] + "..."
   135→        lines.append(f"| {h} | {v} | {r} |")
   136→    return "\n".join(lines)
   137→
   138→
   139→def _format_disposition_table(
   140→    dispositions: dict[str, dict],
   141→    assessments: list[dict],
   142→) -> str:
   143→    """Format the unified disposition map for downstream stages.
   144→
   145→    Partitions issues into:
   146→    - Auto-skipped by observe (false-positive/exaggerated)
   147→    - Genuine issues requiring disposition
   148→    - Actionability-flagged issues (over-engineering/not-worth-it)
   149→    """
   150→    if not dispositions and not assessments:
   151→        return ""
   152→
   153→    auto_skipped: list[dict] = []
   154→    genuine: list[dict] = []
   155→    actionability: list[dict] = []
   156→
   157→    # Build from assessments for hash display, enriched by dispositions
   158→    for a in assessments:
   159→        h = a.get("hash", "?")
   160→        v = a.get("verdict", "?")
   161→        r = a.get("recommendation", "")
   162→        if len(r) > 80:
   163→            r = r[:77] + "..."
   164→        entry = {"hash": h, "verdict": v, "recommendation": r}
   165→
   166→        if v in ("false positive", "exaggerated"):
   167→            auto_skipped.append(entry)
   168→        elif v in ("over engineering", "not worth it"):
   169→            actionability.append(entry)
   170→        else:
   171→            genuine.append(entry)
   172→
   173→    lines = ["### Issue Disposition Summary\n"]
   174→
   175→    if auto_skipped:
   176→        lines.append(f"**Auto-skipped by observe ({len(auto_skipped)} issues)** — no action needed:\n")
   177→        lines.append("| Hash | Verdict | Recommendation |")
   178→        lines.append("|------|---------|----------------|")
   179→        for e in auto_skipped:
   180→            lines.append(f"| {e['hash']} | {e['verdict']} | {e['recommendation']} |")
   181→        lines.append("")
   182→
   183→    if genuine:
   184→        lines.append(f"**Genuine issues requiring disposition ({len(genuine)} issues):**\n")
   185→        lines.append("| Hash | Verdict | Recommendation |")
   186→        lines.append("|------|---------|----------------|")
   187→        for e in genuine:
   188→            lines.append(f"| {e['hash']} | {e['verdict']} | {e['recommendation']} |")
   189→        lines.append("")
   190→
   191→    if actionability:
   192→        lines.append(
   193→            f"**Actionability-flagged issues ({len(actionability)} issues)** "
   194→            "— observe thinks these aren't worth it, reflect decides:\n"
   195→        )
   196→        lines.append("| Hash | Verdict | Recommendation |")
   197→        lines.append("|------|---------|----------------|")
   198→        for e in actionability:
   199→            lines.append(f"| {e['hash']} | {e['verdict']} | {e['recommendation']} |")
   200→        lines.append("")
   201→
   202→    return "\n".join(lines)

   232→    prior_reports: dict[str, str],
   233→    stages_data: dict | None = None,
   234→) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
   235→    """Return the stage reports that matter for the current stage."""
   236→    wanted = {
   237→        "reflect": ("observe",),
   238→        "organize": ("reflect",),
   239→        "enrich": ("organize",),
   240→        "sense-check": ("organize", "enrich"),
   241→    }.get(stage, tuple(prior_reports))
   242→    result = [(name, prior_reports[name]) for name in wanted if name in prior_reports]
   243→
   244→    # Append structured observe assessments / disposition table for downstream stages
   245→    if stage in {"reflect", "organize", "sense-check"} and stages_data:
   246→        observe_data = stages_data.get("observe", {})
   247→        assessments = observe_data.get("assessments", [])
   248→
   249→        # Use disposition table when dispositions exist, fall back to assessments table.
   250→        # Note: stages_data is the triage_stages dict; dispositions are on
   251→        # epic_triage_meta which we don't have here. Use assessments to build
   252→        # the partitioned view since the verdict info is the same.
   253→        if assessments:
   254→            disp_table = _format_disposition_table({}, assessments)
   255→            if disp_table:
   256→                result.append(("observe-dispositions", disp_table))
   257→            else:
   258→                table = _format_assessments_table(assessments)
   259→                if table:
   260→                    result.append(("observe-assessments", table))
   261→        if stage == "organize":
   262→            evidence = _format_assessment_file_evidence(assessments)
   263→            if evidence:
   264→                result.append(("observe-evidence", evidence))
   265→
   266→    return result
   267→
   268→
   269→def build_stage_prompt(
   270→    stage: str,
   271→    triage_input: TriageInput,
   272→    prior_reports: dict[str, str],
   273→    *,
   274→    repo_root: Path,
   275→    mode: PromptMode = "self_record",
   276→    cli_command: str = "desloppify",
   277→    stages_data: dict | None = None,
   278→) -> str:
   279→    """Build a complete subagent prompt for a triage stage."""
   280→    parts: list[str] = []
   281→
   282→    # Preamble
   283→    parts.append(
   284→        triage_prompt_preamble(mode).format(
   285→            stage=stage.upper(),
   286→            repo_root=repo_root,
   287→            cli_command=cli_command,
   288→        )
   289→    )
   290→
   291→    # Prior stage reports
   292→    relevant_prior_reports = _relevant_prior_reports(stage, prior_reports, stages_data)
   293→    if relevant_prior_reports:
   294→        parts.append("## Prior Stage Reports\n")
   295→        for prior_stage, report in relevant_prior_reports:
   296→            parts.append(f"### {prior_stage.upper()} Report\n{report}\n")
   297→
   298→    # Issue data / summary
   299→    parts.append(_issue_context_for_stage(stage, triage_input, mode))
   300→
   301→    # Stage-specific instructions
   302→    instruction_fn = _STAGE_INSTRUCTIONS.get(stage)
   303→    if instruction_fn:
   304→        parts.append(instruction_fn(mode))
   305→
   306→    # CLI reference
   307→    if mode == "self_record":
   308→        parts.append(render_cli_reference(cli_command))
   309→
   310→    # Validation requirements
   311→    parts.append(_validation_requirements(stage))
   312→
   313→    return "\n\n".join(parts)
   314→
   315→
   316→def cmd_stage_prompt(
   317→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   318→    *,
   319→    services: TriageServices | None = None,
   320→) -> None:
   321→    """Print the current prompt for a triage stage, built from live plan data."""
   322→    stage = args.stage_prompt
   323→    resolved_services = services or default_triage_services()
   324→    plan = resolved_services.load_plan()
   325→    runtime = resolved_services.command_runtime(args)
   326→    state = runtime.state
   327→    si = resolved_services.collect_triage_input(plan, state)
   328→    repo_root = get_project_root()
   329→
   330→    # Extract real prior reports from plan.json
   331→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   332→    stages = meta.get("triage_stages", {})
   333→    prior_reports: dict[str, str] = {}
   334→    for prior_stage in _STAGES:
   335→        if prior_stage == stage:
   336→            break
   337→        report = stages.get(prior_stage, {}).get("report", "")
   338→        if report:
   339→            prior_reports[prior_stage] = report
   340→
   341→    prompt = build_stage_prompt(stage, si, prior_reports, repo_root=repo_root, stages_data=stages)
   342→    print(prompt)
   343→
   344→
   345→__all__ = [
   346→    "build_observe_batch_prompt",
   347→    "build_sense_check_content_prompt",
   348→    "build_sense_check_structure_prompt",
   349→    "build_sense_check_value_prompt",
   350→    "build_stage_prompt",
   351→    "cmd_stage_prompt",
   352→    "_observe_batch_instructions",
   353→    "_validation_requirements",
   354→]
   355→

  "replace_all": false,

  "old_string": "__all__ = [\n    \"ReflectDisposition\",\n    \"analyze_reflect_issue_accounting\",\n    \"parse_reflect_dispositions\",\n    \"validate_reflect_accounting\",\n]",
  "new_string": "BacklogDecisionKind = Literal[\"promote\", \"skip\", \"supersede\"]\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass BacklogDecision:\n    \"\"\"One auto-cluster's intended disposition as declared by the reflect stage.\"\"\"\n\n    cluster_name: str\n    decision: BacklogDecisionKind\n    reason: str = \"\"\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict:\n        \"\"\"Serialize for JSON persistence.\"\"\"\n        d: dict = {\"cluster_name\": self.cluster_name, \"decision\": self.decision}\n        if self.reason:\n            d[\"reason\"] = self.reason\n        return d\n\n    @classmethod\n    def from_dict(cls, data: dict | BacklogDecision) -> BacklogDecision:\n        \"\"\"Deserialize from persisted plan data, or pass through unchanged.\"\"\"\n        if isinstance(data, cls):\n            return data\n        return cls(\n            cluster_name=data.get(\"cluster_name\", \"\"),\n            decision=data.get(\"decision\", \"skip\"),  # type: ignore[arg-type]\n            reason=data.get(\"reason\", \"\"),\n        )\n\n\n_BACKLOG_DECISION_RE = re.compile(\n    r\"-\\s*(\\S+)\\s*->\\s*(promote|skip|supersede)\\b\\s*(.*)\",\n    re.IGNORECASE,\n)\n\n\ndef _iter_backlog_decisions_lines(report: str) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Extract lines from the ## Backlog Decisions section of a reflect report.\"\"\"\n    found_section = False\n    in_section = False\n    lines: list[str] = []\n    for raw_line in report.splitlines():\n        line = raw_line.strip()\n        if re.fullmatch(r\"##\\s+Backlog Decisions\", line, re.IGNORECASE):\n            found_section = True\n            in_section = True\n            continue\n        if in_section and re.match(r\"##\\s+\", line):\n            break\n        if in_section:\n            lines.append(line)\n    return found_section, lines\n\n\ndef parse_backlog_decisions(report: str) -> list[BacklogDecision]:\n    \"\"\"Parse structured backlog decisions from the ## Backlog Decisions section.\"\"\"\n    _, lines = _iter_backlog_decisions_lines(report)\n    decisions: list[BacklogDecision] = []\n    for line in lines:\n        match = _BACKLOG_DECISION_RE.match(line)\n        if not match:\n            continue\n        cluster_name = match.group(1).strip().strip(\"`\")\n        decision_raw = match.group(2).strip().lower()\n        reason = match.group(3).strip().strip('\"\\'')\n        if decision_raw in (\"promote\", \"skip\", \"supersede\"):\n            decisions.append(BacklogDecision(\n                cluster_name=cluster_name,\n                decision=decision_raw,  # type: ignore[arg-type]\n                reason=reason,\n            ))\n    return decisions\n\n\ndef validate_backlog_decisions(\n    *,\n    report: str,\n    auto_cluster_names: list[str],\n) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Warn when auto-clusters exist but no backlog decisions section is found.\n\n    Returns ``(ok, warnings)`` — always ``ok=True`` (non-blocking), but\n    populates warnings when backlog decisions are missing or incomplete.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not auto_cluster_names:\n        return True, []\n\n    found_section, _ = _iter_backlog_decisions_lines(report)\n    if not found_section:\n        return True, [\n            f\"Reflect report has {len(auto_cluster_names)} auto-cluster(s) in the backlog \"\n            \"but no `## Backlog Decisions` section. Each auto-cluster should have an \"\n            \"explicit decision: promote, skip (with reason), or supersede.\"\n        ]\n\n    decisions = parse_backlog_decisions(report)\n    decided_names = {d.cluster_name for d in decisions}\n    missing = [name for name in auto_cluster_names if name not in decided_names]\n    if missing:\n        missing_str = \", \".join(missing[:10])\n        suffix = f\" (and {len(missing) - 10} more)\" if len(missing) > 10 else \"\"\n        return True, [\n            f\"Backlog Decisions section is missing decisions for {len(missing)} \"\n            f\"auto-cluster(s): {missing_str}{suffix}\"\n        ]\n\n    return True, []\n\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"BacklogDecision\",\n    \"ReflectDisposition\",\n    \"analyze_reflect_issue_accounting\",\n    \"parse_backlog_decisions\",\n    \"parse_reflect_dispositions\",\n    \"validate_backlog_decisions\",\n    \"validate_reflect_accounting\",\n]"
}

  "old_string": "__all__ = [\n    \"ActualDisposition\",\n    \"LedgerMismatch\",\n    \"_clusters_enriched_or_error\",\n    \"_manual_clusters_or_error\",\n    \"_organize_report_or_error\",\n    \"_unclustered_review_issues_or_error\",\n    \"_validate_organize_against_ledger_or_error\",\n    \"validate_organize_against_dispositions\",\n    \"validate_organize_against_reflect_ledger\",\n]",
  "new_string": "def validate_backlog_promotions_executed(\n    *,\n    plan: dict,\n    stages: dict,\n) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Warn when reflect requested backlog promotions that organize didn't execute.\n\n    Returns a list of warning strings (non-blocking). Empty means all good.\n    \"\"\"\n    reflect_data = stages.get(\"reflect\", {})\n    raw_decisions = reflect_data.get(\"backlog_decisions\", [])\n    if not raw_decisions:\n        return []\n\n    decisions = [BacklogDecision.from_dict(d) for d in raw_decisions]\n    promote_decisions = [d for d in decisions if d.decision == \"promote\"]\n    if not promote_decisions:\n        return []\n\n    # Check which promoted clusters actually got promoted (are in queue_order\n    # or have execution_status set to active)\n    clusters = plan.get(\"clusters\", {})\n    warnings: list[str] = []\n    for decision in promote_decisions:\n        cluster = clusters.get(decision.cluster_name)\n        if cluster is None:\n            continue\n        # A promoted cluster should have been activated\n        execution_status = cluster.get(\"execution_status\", \"\")\n        if execution_status not in (\"active\", \"in_progress\"):\n            warnings.append(\n                f\"Reflect requested promoting {decision.cluster_name} \"\n                f\"but it was not promoted during organize.\"\n            )\n    return warnings\n\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"ActualDisposition\",\n    \"LedgerMismatch\",\n    \"_clusters_enriched_or_error\",\n    \"_manual_clusters_or_error\",\n    \"_organize_report_or_error\",\n    \"_unclustered_review_issues_or_error\",\n    \"_validate_organize_against_ledger_or_error\",\n    \"validate_backlog_promotions_executed\",\n    \"validate_organize_against_dispositions\",\n    \"validate_organize_against_reflect_ledger\",\n]"
}

   145→def _recurring_dimensions(

   149→    open_by_dim: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   150→    for issue_id, issue in review_issues.items():

   152→        if dimension:

   160→

   162→    for dimension in sorted(set(open_by_dim) & set(resolved_by_dim)):
   163→        recurring[dimension] = {

   165→            "resolved": sorted(resolved_by_dim[dimension]),

   178→        if is_triage_finding(issue):

   181→        open_mechanical[issue_id] = issue

   186→    last_completed = meta.get("last_completed_at", "")
   187→    all_completed: list[dict] = plan.get("completed_clusters", [])
   188→    if not last_completed:
   189→        return list(all_completed)
   190→    return [
   191→        cluster for cluster in all_completed
   192→        if cluster.get("completed_at", "") > last_completed
   193→    ]

   196→def collect_triage_input(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> TriageInput:
   197→    """Gather all data needed for the triage LLM prompt."""
   198→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   199→    issues = (state.get("work_items") or state.get("issues", {}))
   200→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   201→    epics = triage_clusters(plan)
   202→    auto_clusters = {
   203→        name: cluster
   204→        for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items()
   205→        if cluster.get("auto") and not name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX)
   206→    }
   207→    open_review, open_mechanical = _split_open_issue_buckets(issues)
   208→    snapshot = build_triage_snapshot(plan, state)
   209→
   210→    triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   211→    current_review_ids = set(open_review.keys())
   212→    new_since = set(snapshot.new_since_triage_ids)
   213→    resolved_since = triaged_ids - current_review_ids
   214→    previously_dismissed = list(meta.get("dismissed_ids", []))
   215→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   216→
   217→    # Resolved issue objects (for REFLECT stage)
   218→    resolved_issue_objs = {
   219→        fid: issues[fid] for fid in resolved_since if fid in issues
   220→    }
   221→
   222→    return TriageInput(
   223→        review_issues=open_review,
   224→        objective_backlog_issues=open_mechanical,
   225→        auto_clusters=auto_clusters,
   226→        existing_clusters=dict(epics),
   227→        dimension_scores=state.get("dimension_scores", {}),
   228→        new_since_last=new_since,
   229→        resolved_since_last=resolved_since,
   230→        previously_dismissed=previously_dismissed,

   232→        resolved_issues=resolved_issue_objs,

   234→    )

   236→_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
   237→You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Produce a coherent
   238→prioritized strategy for all open review issues, and decide which mechanical
   239→backlog items should be promoted into the active queue now.
   240→
   241→Your plan should:
   242→- Cluster issues by ROOT CAUSE, not by dimension or detector
   243→- Give each cluster a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
   244→- Order clusters by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense
   245→- Dismiss issues that don't make sense, are contradictory, or are false positives
   246→- Mark which clusters are agent-safe (can be executed mechanically) vs need human judgment
   247→- Avoid creating work that contradicts other work in the plan
   248→- Be ambitious but realistic — aim to resolve all issues coherently
   249→
   250→Available directions for clusters: delete, merge, flatten, enforce, simplify, decompose, extract, inline.
   251→
   252→Available plan tools (the agent executing your plan has access to these):
   253→- `desloppify plan queue` — view the explicit execution queue in priority order
   254→- `desloppify backlog` — inspect broader open work outside the execution queue
   255→- `desloppify plan promote <id-or-pattern>` — move backlog work into the active queue
   256→- `desloppify plan focus <name>` — focus the queue on one cluster
   257→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   258→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   259→- `desloppify plan resolve <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   260→- `desloppify plan reorder <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   261→- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   262→- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   263→- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review issues
   264→
   265→Your output defines the active work plan for review findings and any explicitly
   266→promoted backlog work. Mechanical backlog items you do not mention remain in
   267→backlog by default. Dismissed issues will be removed from the queue with your
   268→stated reason.
   269→
   270→Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
   271→{
   272→  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
   273→  "clusters": [
   274→    {
   275→      "name": "slug-name",
   276→      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
   277→      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
   278→      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
   279→      "issue_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
   280→      "dismissed": ["id3"],
   281→      "agent_safe": true,
   282→      "dependency_order": 1,
   283→      "action_steps": [
   284→        {
   285→          "title": "Short imperative step title",
   286→          "detail": "Concrete implementation detail with file paths/locations",
   287→          "issue_refs": ["id1"]
   288→        }
   289→      ],
   290→      "status": "pending"
   291→    }
   292→  ],
   293→  "dismissed_issues": [
   294→    {"issue_id": "id", "reason": "why this issue doesn't make sense"}
   295→  ],
   296→  "contradiction_notes": [
   297→    {"kept": "issue_id", "dismissed": "issue_id", "reason": "why"}
   298→  ],
   299→  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is",
   300→  "auto_cluster_decisions": [
   301→    {"cluster": "auto/security", "action": "promote", "priority": "first", "reason": "high-value security fixes"},
   302→    {"cluster": "auto/unused", "action": "skip", "reason": "mostly test assert noise"},
   303→    {"cluster": "auto/test_coverage", "action": "break_up", "reason": "split by module", "sub_clusters": ["auto/test_coverage_api", "auto/test_coverage_core"]}
   304→  ]
   305→}
   306→"""
   307→
   308→def _append_existing_clusters_section(parts: list[str], clusters: dict[str, Cluster]) -> None:
   309→    if not clusters:
   310→        return
   311→    parts.append("## Existing clusters")
   312→    for name, cluster in sorted(clusters.items()):
   313→        status = cluster.get("status", "pending")
   314→        thesis = cluster.get("thesis", "")
   315→        direction = cluster.get("direction", "")
   316→        issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   317→        parts.append(
   318→            f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
   319→            f"\n  Issues: {', '.join(issue_ids[:10])}"
   320→            f"{'...' if len(issue_ids) > 10 else ''}"
   321→        )
   322→    parts.append("")
   323→
   324→
   325→def _append_changed_issue_section(
   326→    parts: list[str],
   327→    *,
   328→    title: str,
   329→    issue_ids: set[str],
   330→    issues: dict[str, dict] | None = None,
   331→) -> None:
   332→    if not issue_ids:
   333→        return
   334→    parts.append(f"## {title} ({len(issue_ids)})")
   335→    for issue_id in sorted(issue_ids):
   336→        if issues is None:
   337→            parts.append(f"- {issue_id}")
   338→            continue
   339→        issue = issues.get(issue_id, {})
   340→        parts.append(f"- {issue_id}: {issue.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   341→    parts.append("")
   342→
   343→
   344→def _append_resolved_issue_context(parts: list[str], resolved_issues: dict[str, dict]) -> None:
   345→    if not resolved_issues:
   346→        return
   347→    parts.append(
   348→        "## Resolved review issues available for recurrence context "
   349→        f"({len(resolved_issues)})"
   350→    )
   351→    resolved_ids = sorted(resolved_issues)
   352→    for issue_id in resolved_ids[:30]:
   353→        issue = resolved_issues.get(issue_id, {})
   354→        summary = str(issue.get("summary", "(no summary)"))
   355→        dimension = _issue_dimension(issue)
   356→        dim_suffix = f" [{dimension}]" if dimension else ""
   357→        parts.append(f"- {issue_id}{dim_suffix}: {summary}")
   358→    if len(resolved_ids) > 30:
   359→        parts.append(f"- ... and {len(resolved_ids) - 30} more resolved issues")
   360→    parts.append("")
   361→
   362→
   363→def _append_completed_clusters_section(parts: list[str], completed_clusters: list[dict]) -> None:
   364→    if not completed_clusters:
   365→        return
   366→    parts.append(
   367→        "## Completed clusters since last triage "
   368→        f"({len(completed_clusters)})"
   369→    )
   370→    completed = sorted(
   371→        completed_clusters,
   372→        key=lambda cluster: str(cluster.get("completed_at", "")),
   373→        reverse=True,
   374→    )
   375→    for cluster in completed[:10]:
   376→        name = str(cluster.get("name", "(unnamed cluster)"))
   377→        thesis = str(cluster.get("thesis") or cluster.get("description") or "")
   378→        completed_at = str(cluster.get("completed_at", ""))
   379→        issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   380→        issue_count = len(issue_ids) if isinstance(issue_ids, list) else 0
   381→        parts.append(
   382→            f"- {name}: {thesis} (issues: {issue_count}, completed_at: {completed_at})"
   383→        )
   384→    if len(completed) > 10:
   385→        parts.append(f"- ... and {len(completed) - 10} more completed clusters")
   386→    parts.append("")
   387→
   388→
   389→def _append_recurring_dimensions_section(
   390→    parts: list[str],
   391→    review_issues: dict[str, dict],
   392→    resolved_issues: dict[str, dict],
   393→) -> None:
   394→    recurring = _recurring_dimensions(review_issues, resolved_issues)
   395→    if not recurring:
   396→        return
   397→    parts.append(
   398→        "## Potential recurring dimensions (resolved issues still have open peers)"
   399→    )
   400→    for dimension, bucket in recurring.items():
   401→        open_count = len(bucket["open"])
   402→        resolved_count = len(bucket["resolved"])
   403→        parts.append(
   404→            f"- {dimension}: {open_count} open / {resolved_count} recently resolved"
   405→        )
   406→    parts.append("")
   407→
   408→
   409→def _append_open_review_issues_section(parts: list[str], review_issues: dict[str, dict]) -> None:
   410→    parts.append(f"## All open review issues ({len(review_issues)})")
   411→    for issue_id, issue in sorted(review_issues.items()):
   412→        detail = issue.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(issue.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   413→        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   414→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   415→        confidence = issue.get("confidence", "medium")
   416→        file_path = issue.get("file", "")
   417→        summary = issue.get("summary", "")
   418→        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {issue_id}")
   419→        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   420→        if dimension:
   421→            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   422→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   423→        if suggestion:
   424→            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   425→    parts.append("")
   426→
   427→
   428→def _append_dimension_scores_section(parts: list[str], dimension_scores: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   429→    if not dimension_scores:
   430→        return
   431→    parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   432→    for name, data in sorted(dimension_scores.items()):
   433→        if not isinstance(data, dict):
   434→            continue
   435→        score = data.get("score", "?")
   436→        strict = data.get("strict", score)
   437→        issues = data.get("failing", 0)
   438→        parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   439→    parts.append("")
   440→
   441→
   442→def _append_mechanical_backlog_section(
   443→    parts: list[str],
   444→    objective_backlog_issues: dict[str, dict],
   445→    auto_clusters: dict[str, dict],
   446→) -> None:
   447→    if not objective_backlog_issues:
   448→        return
   449→
   450→    clustered_ids: set[str] = set()
   451→    for cluster in auto_clusters.values():
   452→        issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   453→        if isinstance(issue_ids, list):
   454→            clustered_ids.update(
   455→                issue_id
   456→                for issue_id in issue_ids
   457→                if isinstance(issue_id, str) and issue_id in objective_backlog_issues
   458→            )
   459→
   460→    unclustered = {
   461→        issue_id: issue
   462→        for issue_id, issue in objective_backlog_issues.items()
   463→        if issue_id not in clustered_ids
   464→    }
   465→    clustered_issue_count = len(clustered_ids)
   466→    auto_cluster_count = sum(
   467→        1 for cluster in auto_clusters.values()
   468→        if any(
   469→            isinstance(issue_id, str) and issue_id in objective_backlog_issues
   470→            for issue_id in cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   471→        )
   472→    )
   473→
   474→    parts.append(
   475→        "## Mechanical backlog "
   476→        f"({len(objective_backlog_issues)} items: {clustered_issue_count} in "
   477→        f"{auto_cluster_count} auto-clusters, {len(unclustered)} unclustered)"
   478→    )
   479→    parts.append(
   480→        "These detector-created items stay in backlog unless you explicitly promote them into the active queue."
   481→    )
   482→    parts.append(
   483→        "You MUST make an explicit decision for each auto-cluster listed below. "
   484→        "Include every auto-cluster in your `auto_cluster_decisions` output with one of: "
   485→        "promote (add to active queue with a priority position), "
   486→        "skip (leave in backlog with a reason), or "
   487→        "break_up (split into smaller sub-clusters with a reason)."
   488→    )
   489→
   490→    rendered_clusters: list[tuple[str, dict, int]] = []
   491→    for name, cluster in auto_clusters.items():
   492→        raw_issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   493→        if not isinstance(raw_issue_ids, list):
   494→            continue
   495→        member_count = sum(
   496→            1 for issue_id in raw_issue_ids
   497→            if isinstance(issue_id, str) and issue_id in objective_backlog_issues
   498→        )
   499→        if member_count <= 0:
   500→            continue
   501→        rendered_clusters.append((name, cluster, member_count))
   502→
   503→    if rendered_clusters:
   504→        parts.append("### Auto-clusters (decision required for each)")
   505→        parts.append(
   506→            "These are pre-grouped detector findings. You must decide for each cluster: "
   507→            "promote (into active queue), skip (with reason), or break_up (into sub-clusters). "
   508→            "Include your decisions in the `auto_cluster_decisions` array in your response."
   509→        )
   510→        rendered_clusters.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[2], item[0]))
   511→        visible_clusters = rendered_clusters[:15]
   512→        for name, cluster, member_count in visible_clusters:
   513→            autofix_hint = _cluster_autofix_hint(cluster)
   514→            hint_suffix = f" [autofix: {autofix_hint}]" if autofix_hint else ""
   515→            summary = _cluster_backlog_summary(name, cluster, member_count)
   516→            parts.append(f"- {name} ({member_count} items){hint_suffix}")
   517→            parts.append(f"  {summary}")
   518→        if len(rendered_clusters) > len(visible_clusters):
   519→            remaining = rendered_clusters[len(visible_clusters):]
   520→            remaining_issues = sum(item[2] for item in remaining)
   521→            parts.append(
   522→                f"- ... and {len(remaining)} more clusters ({remaining_issues} issues)"
   523→            )
   524→
   525→    if unclustered:
   526→        parts.append(
   527→            f"### Unclustered items ({len(unclustered)} items — needs human judgment or isolated findings)"
   528→        )
   529→        parts.append(
   530→            "Promote individually with `desloppify plan promote <issue-id>`, or group related items into a manual cluster."
   531→        )
   532→        sample_ids = sorted(
   533→            unclustered,
   534→            key=lambda issue_id: (
   535→                _confidence_sort_key(unclustered[issue_id]),
   536→                issue_id,
   537→            ),
   538→        )[:10]
   539→        for issue_id in sample_ids:
   540→            issue = unclustered[issue_id]
   541→            confidence = str(issue.get("confidence", "medium"))
   542→            summary = str(issue.get("summary", "(no summary)"))
   543→            parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {issue_id} — {summary}")
   544→        if len(unclustered) > len(sample_ids):
   545→            parts.append(
   546→                f"- ... and {len(unclustered) - len(sample_ids)} more unclustered items"
   547→            )
   548→
   549→    parts.append("Browse full backlog: `desloppify backlog`")
   550→    parts.append("Inspect a cluster: `desloppify plan cluster show auto/<name>`")
   551→    parts.append("Inspect an issue: `desloppify show <issue-id>`")
   552→    parts.append("")
   553→
   554→
   555→def _cluster_autofix_hint(cluster: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
   556→    return cluster_autofix_hint(cluster) or ""
   557→
   558→
   559→def _cluster_backlog_summary(name: str, cluster: dict[str, Any], member_count: int) -> str:
   560→    description = str(cluster.get("description") or "").strip()
   561→    if description:
   562→        return description
   563→    title = name.removeprefix("auto/").replace("-", " ")
   564→    if title:
   565→        return f"Address {member_count} {title} findings"
   566→    return f"Address {member_count} detector findings"
   567→
   568→
   569→def _confidence_sort_key(issue: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
   570→    confidence = str(issue.get("confidence", "medium")).lower()
   571→    order = {"high": 0, "medium": 1, "low": 2}
   572→    return order.get(confidence, 1)
   573→
   574→
   575→def _append_previously_dismissed_section(parts: list[str], dismissed_ids: list[str]) -> None:
   576→    if not dismissed_ids:
   577→        return
   578→    parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(dismissed_ids)})")
   579→    parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   580→    for issue_id in dismissed_ids:
   581→        parts.append(f"- {issue_id}")
   582→    parts.append("")
   583→
   584→
   585→def build_triage_prompt(si: TriageInput) -> str:
   586→    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all issue data."""
   587→    parts: list[str] = []
   588→    _append_existing_clusters_section(parts, si.existing_clusters)
   589→    _append_changed_issue_section(
   590→        parts,
   591→        title="New issues since last triage",
   592→        issue_ids=si.new_since_last,
   593→        issues=si.review_issues,
   594→    )
   595→    _append_changed_issue_section(
   596→        parts,
   597→        title="Resolved since last triage",
   598→        issue_ids=si.resolved_since_last,
   599→    )
   600→    _append_resolved_issue_context(parts, si.resolved_issues)
   601→    _append_completed_clusters_section(parts, si.completed_clusters)
   602→    _append_recurring_dimensions_section(parts, si.review_issues, si.resolved_issues)
   603→    _append_open_review_issues_section(parts, si.review_issues)
   604→    _append_dimension_scores_section(parts, si.dimension_scores)
   605→    _append_mechanical_backlog_section(
   606→        parts,
   607→        si.objective_backlog_issues,
   608→        si.auto_clusters,
   609→    )
   610→    _append_previously_dismissed_section(parts, si.previously_dismissed)
   611→    return "\n".join(parts)
   612→
   613→__all__ = [
   614→    "_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT",
   615→    "AutoClusterDecision",
   616→    "ContradictionNote",
   617→    "DismissedIssue",
   618→    "TriageInput",
   619→    "TriageResult",
   620→    "build_triage_prompt",
   621→    "collect_triage_input",
   622→]

    40→def last_real_review_timestamp(state: dict) -> str | None:
    41→    """ISO timestamp of most recent genuine review import (not manual override/scan reset)."""
    42→    real_modes = {"holistic", "per_file", "trusted_internal", "attested_external"}
    43→    audit = state.get("assessment_import_audit", [])
    44→    if isinstance(audit, list):
    45→        for entry in reversed(audit):
    46→            if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("mode") in real_modes:
    47→                ts = entry.get("timestamp")
    48→                if ts:
    49→                    return str(ts)
    50→    holistic = (state.get("review_cache") or {}).get("holistic")
    51→    if isinstance(holistic, dict):
    52→        return holistic.get("reviewed_at")
    53→    return None
    54→
    55→
    56→def detect_recurring_patterns(
    57→    open_issues: dict[str, dict],
    58→    resolved_issues: dict[str, dict],
    59→) -> dict[str, dict]:
    60→    """Detect dimensions with both resolved AND current open issues.
    61→
    62→    Returns ``{dimension: {"open": [ids], "resolved": [ids]}}``.
    63→    A dimension with both resolved and open issues signals a potential
    64→    loop — similar issues recur after previous fixes.
    65→    """
    66→
    67→    def _dimension(finding: dict) -> str:
    68→        detail = finding.get("detail", {})
    69→        if isinstance(detail, dict):
    70→            return detail.get("dimension", "")
    71→        return ""
    72→
    73→    open_by_dim: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    74→    for fid, finding in open_issues.items():
    75→        dim = _dimension(finding)
    76→        if dim:
    77→            open_by_dim.setdefault(dim, []).append(fid)
    78→
    79→    resolved_by_dim: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    80→    for fid, finding in resolved_issues.items():
    81→        dim = _dimension(finding)
    82→        if dim:
    83→            resolved_by_dim.setdefault(dim, []).append(fid)
    84→
    85→    recurring: dict[str, dict] = {}
    86→    for dim in set(open_by_dim) & set(resolved_by_dim):
    87→        recurring[dim] = {
    88→            "open": open_by_dim[dim],
    89→            "resolved": resolved_by_dim[dim],
    90→        }
    91→    return recurring
    92→
    93→
    94→@dataclass
    95→class TriageDeps:
    96→    """Injectable dependencies for the triage engine."""
    97→
    98→    llm_call: Any = None  # Callable[[str, str], str] — (system, user) -> response
    99→
   100→
   101→def triage_epics(
   102→    plan: PlanModel,
   103→    state: StateModel,
   104→    *,
   105→    deps: TriageDeps | None = None,
   106→    dry_run: bool = False,
   107→    trigger: str = "manual",
   108→) -> TriageMutationResult:
   109→    """Run legacy whole-plan triage: collect input, call LLM, apply results.
   110→
   111→    If ``dry_run`` is True, collects input and builds prompt but does not
   112→    call the LLM or mutate the plan.
   113→
   114→    If ``deps.llm_call`` is None, returns a dry-run result with the prompt.
   115→    """
   116→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   117→    si = collect_triage_input(plan, state)
   118→
   119→    prompt = build_triage_prompt(si)
   120→    valid_ids = set(si.review_issues.keys())
   121→
   122→    if dry_run or deps is None or deps.llm_call is None:
   123→        result = TriageMutationResult(dry_run=True)
   124→        result.strategy_summary = f"[dry-run] Prompt built with {len(si.review_issues)} issues"
   125→        return result
   126→
   127→    try:
   128→        raw_response = deps.llm_call(_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
   129→        raw_json = json.loads(raw_response)
   130→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
   131→        logger.error("Cluster triage LLM response parse error: %s", exc)
   132→        result = TriageMutationResult()
   133→        result.strategy_summary = f"Triage failed: {exc}"
   134→        return result
   135→
   136→    triage = parse_triage_result(raw_json, valid_ids)
   137→    return apply_triage_to_plan(plan, state, triage, trigger=trigger)
   138→

    23→@dataclass
    24→class TriageMutationResult:
    25→    """What changed when triage was applied to the plan."""
    26→
    27→    epics_created: int = 0
    28→    epics_updated: int = 0
    29→    epics_completed: int = 0
    30→    issues_dismissed: int = 0
    31→    issues_reassigned: int = 0
    32→    strategy_summary: str = ""
    33→    triage_version: int = 0
    34→    dry_run: bool = False
    35→    auto_clusters_promoted: int = 0
    36→    auto_clusters_skipped: int = 0
    37→    auto_clusters_broken_up: int = 0
    38→
    39→    @property
    40→    def clusters_created(self) -> int:
    41→        return self.epics_created
    42→
    43→    @property
    44→    def clusters_updated(self) -> int:
    45→        return self.epics_updated
    46→
    47→    @property
    48→    def clusters_completed(self) -> int:
    49→        return self.epics_completed
    50→
    51→
    52→def _epic_sort_key(epic_data: dict) -> int:
    53→    return int(epic_data.get("dependency_order", 999))
    54→
    55→
    56→def _normalized_epic_name(raw_name: str) -> str:
    57→    return raw_name if raw_name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX) else f"{EPIC_PREFIX}{raw_name}"
    58→
    59→
    60→def _update_existing_epic_cluster(
    61→    existing: Cluster,
    62→    epic_data: dict,
    63→    *,
    64→    now: str,
    65→    version: int,
    66→) -> None:
    67→    existing["thesis"] = epic_data["thesis"]
    68→    existing["direction"] = epic_data["direction"]
    69→    existing["root_cause"] = epic_data.get("root_cause", "")
    70→    existing["issue_ids"] = epic_data["issue_ids"]
    71→    existing["dismissed"] = epic_data.get("dismissed", [])
    72→    existing["agent_safe"] = epic_data.get("agent_safe", False)
    73→    existing["dependency_order"] = epic_data["dependency_order"]
    74→    existing["action_steps"] = epic_data.get("action_steps", [])
    75→    existing["execution_status"] = EXECUTION_STATUS_ACTIVE
    76→    existing["updated_at"] = now
    77→    existing["triage_version"] = version
    78→    existing["description"] = epic_data["thesis"]
    79→    # Don't overwrite in_progress status from agent
    80→    if existing.get("status") != "in_progress":
    81→        existing["status"] = epic_data.get("status", "pending")
    82→
    83→
    84→def _create_epic_cluster(
    85→    *,
    86→    epic_name: str,
    87→    epic_data: dict,
    88→    now: str,
    89→    version: int,
    90→) -> Cluster:
    91→    return {
    92→        "name": epic_name,
    93→        "description": epic_data["thesis"],
    94→        "issue_ids": epic_data["issue_ids"],
    95→        "auto": True,
    96→        "cluster_key": f"epic::{epic_name}",
    97→        "action": f"desloppify plan focus {epic_name}",
    98→        "execution_status": EXECUTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
    99→        "user_modified": False,
   100→        "created_at": now,
   101→        "updated_at": now,
   102→        # Epic fields
   103→        "thesis": epic_data["thesis"],
   104→        "direction": epic_data["direction"],
   105→        "root_cause": epic_data.get("root_cause", ""),
   106→        "supersedes": [],
   107→        "dismissed": epic_data.get("dismissed", []),
   108→        "agent_safe": epic_data.get("agent_safe", False),
   109→        "dependency_order": epic_data["dependency_order"],
   110→        "action_steps": epic_data.get("action_steps", []),
   111→        "source_clusters": [],
   112→        "status": epic_data.get("status", "pending"),
   113→        "triage_version": version,
   114→    }
   115→
   116→
   117→def _upsert_triage_clusters(
   118→    *,
   119→    clusters: dict[str, Cluster],
   120→    triage: TriageResult,
   121→    now: str,
   122→    version: int,
   123→) -> tuple[int, int]:
   124→    created = 0
   125→    updated = 0
   126→    for epic_data in sorted(triage.clusters, key=_epic_sort_key):
   127→        raw_name = epic_data["name"]
   128→        epic_name = _normalized_epic_name(raw_name)
   129→        existing = clusters.get(epic_name)
   130→        if existing and existing.get("thesis"):
   131→            _update_existing_epic_cluster(existing, epic_data, now=now, version=version)
   132→            updated += 1
   133→            continue
   134→        clusters[epic_name] = _create_epic_cluster(
   135→            epic_name=epic_name,
   136→            epic_data=epic_data,
   137→            now=now,
   138→            version=version,
   139→        )
   140→        created += 1
   141→    return created, updated
   142→
   143→
   144→def _reorder_queue_by_dependency(
   145→    *,
   146→    order: list[str],
   147→    triage: TriageResult,
   148→    dismissed_ids: list[str],
   149→) -> None:
   150→    epic_issue_ids: set[str] = set()
   151→    epic_ordered_ids: list[str] = []
   152→    dismissed_set = set(dismissed_ids)
   153→    for epic_data in sorted(triage.clusters, key=_epic_sort_key):
   154→        for fid in epic_data["issue_ids"]:
   155→            if fid in epic_issue_ids or fid in dismissed_set:
   156→                continue
   157→            epic_issue_ids.add(fid)
   158→            epic_ordered_ids.append(fid)
   159→
   160→    non_epic_items = [fid for fid in order if fid not in epic_issue_ids]
   161→    order.clear()
   162→    order.extend(epic_ordered_ids)
   163→    order.extend(non_epic_items)
   164→
   165→
   166→def _set_triage_meta(
   167→    *,
   168→    plan: PlanModel,
   169→    state: StateModel,
   170→    triage: TriageResult,
   171→    now: str,
   172→    version: int,
   173→    dismissed_ids: list[str],
   174→    trigger: str,
   175→) -> None:
   176→    current_hash = review_issue_snapshot_hash(state)
   177→    open_review_ids = sorted(
   178→        fid
   179→        for fid, issue in (state.get("work_items") or state.get("issues", {})).items()
   180→        if issue.get("status") == "open"
   181→        and is_triage_finding(issue)
   182→    )
   183→
   184→    plan["epic_triage_meta"] = {
   185→        "triaged_ids": open_review_ids,
   186→        "last_run": now,
   187→        "version": version,
   188→        "dismissed_ids": dismissed_ids,
   189→        "issue_snapshot_hash": current_hash,
   190→        "strategy_summary": triage.strategy_summary,
   191→        "trigger": trigger,
   192→    }
   193→
   194→
   195→def _apply_auto_cluster_decisions(
   196→    *,
   197→    plan: PlanModel,
   198→    decisions: list[AutoClusterDecision],
   199→    order: list[str],
   200→    now: str,
   201→    version: int,
   202→    result: TriageMutationResult,
   203→) -> None:
   204→    """Process auto_cluster_decisions from the triage result.
   205→
   206→    - promote: add cluster issue IDs to queue_order
   207→    - skip: mark the cluster as skipped in the plan
   208→    - break_up: record the decision for downstream processing
   209→    """
   210→    clusters = plan["clusters"]
   211→
   212→    for decision in decisions:
   213→        cluster_name = decision.cluster
   214→        cluster = clusters.get(cluster_name)
   215→        if cluster is None:
   216→            continue
   217→
   218→        action = decision.action
   219→
   220→        if action == "promote":
   221→            issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   222→            existing_in_order = set(order)
   223→            new_ids = [
   224→                fid for fid in issue_ids
   225→                if isinstance(fid, str) and fid not in existing_in_order
   226→            ]
   227→            # Determine insertion position based on priority hint
   228→            priority = (decision.priority or "").lower().strip()
   229→            if priority == "first":
   230→                for i, fid in enumerate(new_ids):
   231→                    order.insert(i, fid)
   232→            elif priority.startswith("after "):
   233→                target = priority[len("after "):]
   234→                insert_idx = len(order)
   235→                for idx, item in enumerate(order):
   236→                    if target in item:
   237→                        insert_idx = idx + 1
   238→                        break
   239→                for i, fid in enumerate(new_ids):
   240→                    order.insert(insert_idx + i, fid)
   241→            elif priority.startswith("before "):
   242→                target = priority[len("before "):]
   243→                insert_idx = len(order)
   244→                for idx, item in enumerate(order):
   245→                    if target in item:
   246→                        insert_idx = idx
   247→                        break
   248→                for i, fid in enumerate(new_ids):
   249→                    order.insert(insert_idx + i, fid)
   250→            else:
   251→                # "last" or unrecognized: append to end
   252→                order.extend(new_ids)
   253→
   254→            cluster["execution_status"] = EXECUTION_STATUS_ACTIVE
   255→            cluster["updated_at"] = now
   256→            cluster["triage_version"] = version
   257→            result.auto_clusters_promoted += 1
   258→
   259→        elif action == "skip":
   260→            cluster["triage_skip"] = {
   261→                "reason": decision.reason,
   262→                "skipped_at": now,
   263→                "triage_version": version,
   264→            }
   265→            cluster["updated_at"] = now
   266→            result.auto_clusters_skipped += 1
   267→
   268→        elif action == "break_up":
   269→            cluster["triage_break_up"] = {
   270→                "reason": decision.reason,
   271→                "sub_clusters": decision.sub_clusters,
   272→                "decided_at": now,
   273→                "triage_version": version,
   274→            }
   275→            cluster["updated_at"] = now
   276→            result.auto_clusters_broken_up += 1
   277→
   278→
   279→def apply_triage_to_plan(
   280→    plan: PlanModel,
   281→    state: StateModel,
   282→    triage: TriageResult,
   283→    *,
   284→    trigger: str = "manual",
   285→) -> TriageMutationResult:
   286→    """Apply parsed triage result to the living plan.
   287→
   288→    1. Creates/updates triage clusters in plan["clusters"]
   289→    2. Marks dismissed issues as triaged_out skips
   290→    3. Reorders queue_order to group cluster members by dependency_order
   291→    4. Updates epic_triage_meta with snapshot hash
   292→    """
   293→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   294→    ensure_state_defaults(state)
   295→    now = utc_now()
   296→    result = TriageMutationResult()
   297→    result.strategy_summary = triage.strategy_summary
   298→
   299→    clusters = plan["clusters"]
   300→    skipped: dict = plan["skipped"]
   301→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   302→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   303→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   304→    result.triage_version = version
   305→
   306→    created, updated = _upsert_triage_clusters(
   307→        clusters=clusters,
   308→        triage=triage,
   309→        now=now,
   310→        version=version,
   311→    )
   312→    result.epics_created += created
   313→    result.epics_updated += updated
   314→
   315→    dismissed_ids, dismiss_count = dismiss_triage_issues(
   316→        triage=triage,
   317→        order=order,
   318→        skipped=skipped,
   319→        now=now,
   320→        version=version,
   321→        scan_count=int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   322→    )
   323→    result.issues_dismissed += dismiss_count
   324→
   325→    # Sync state status for dismissed issues so state is authoritative.
   326→    issues = (state.get("work_items") or state.get("issues", {}))
   327→    triaged_out_status = skip_kind_state_status("triaged_out")
   328→    for fid in dismissed_ids:
   329→        issue = issues.get(fid)
   330→        if issue and issue.get("status") == "open" and triaged_out_status:
   331→            issue["status"] = triaged_out_status
   332→            issue["note"] = f"Triaged out by epic triage v{version}"
   333→
   334→    _reorder_queue_by_dependency(
   335→        order=order,
   336→        triage=triage,
   337→        dismissed_ids=dismissed_ids,
   338→    )
   339→
   340→    # Process auto-cluster decisions (backward-compatible: no-op if empty)
   341→    if triage.auto_cluster_decisions:
   342→        _apply_auto_cluster_decisions(
   343→            plan=plan,
   344→            decisions=triage.auto_cluster_decisions,
   345→            order=order,
   346→            now=now,
   347→            version=version,
   348→            result=result,
   349→        )
   350→
   351→    _set_triage_meta(
   352→        plan=plan,
   353→        state=state,
   354→        triage=triage,
   355→        now=now,
   356→        version=version,
   357→        dismissed_ids=dismissed_ids,
   358→        trigger=trigger,
   359→    )
   360→    plan["updated"] = now
   361→
   362→    return result
   363→
   364→__all__ = ["TriageMutationResult", "apply_triage_to_plan"]
   365→
