   254→- `desloppify backlog` — inspect broader open work outside the execution queue
   255→- `desloppify plan promote <id-or-pattern>` — move backlog work into the active queue
   256→- `desloppify plan focus <name>` — focus the queue on one cluster
   257→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   258→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   259→- `desloppify plan resolve <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   260→- `desloppify plan reorder <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   261→- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   262→- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   263→- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review issues
   264→
   265→Your output defines the active work plan for review findings and any explicitly
   266→promoted backlog work. Mechanical backlog items you do not mention remain in
   267→backlog by default. Dismissed issues will be removed from the queue with your
   268→stated reason.
   269→
   270→Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
   271→{
   272→  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
   273→  "clusters": [
   274→    {
   275→      "name": "slug-name",
   276→      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
   277→      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
   278→      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
   279→      "issue_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
   280→      "dismissed": ["id3"],
   281→      "agent_safe": true,
   282→      "dependency_order": 1,
   283→      "action_steps": [
   284→        {
   285→          "title": "Short imperative step title",
   286→          "detail": "Concrete implementation detail with file paths/locations",
   287→          "issue_refs": ["id1"]
   288→        }
   289→      ],
   290→      "status": "pending"
   291→    }
   292→  ],
   293→  "dismissed_issues": [
   294→    {"issue_id": "id", "reason": "why this issue doesn't make sense"}
   295→  ],
   296→  "contradiction_notes": [
   297→    {"kept": "issue_id", "dismissed": "issue_id", "reason": "why"}
   298→  ],
   299→  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is",
   300→  "auto_cluster_decisions": [
   301→    {"cluster": "auto/security", "action": "promote", "priority": "first", "reason": "high-value security fixes"},
   302→    {"cluster": "auto/unused", "action": "skip", "reason": "mostly test assert noise"},
   303→    {"cluster": "auto/test_coverage", "action": "break_up", "reason": "split by module", "sub_clusters": ["auto/test_coverage_api", "auto/test_coverage_core"]}
   304→  ]
   305→}
   306→"""
   307→
   308→def _append_existing_clusters_section(parts: list[str], clusters: dict[str, Cluster]) -> None:
   309→    if not clusters:
   310→        return
   311→    parts.append("## Existing clusters")
   312→    for name, cluster in sorted(clusters.items()):
   313→        status = cluster.get("status", "pending")
   314→        thesis = cluster.get("thesis", "")
   315→        direction = cluster.get("direction", "")
   316→        issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   317→        parts.append(
   318→            f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
   319→            f"\n  Issues: {', '.join(issue_ids[:10])}"
   320→            f"{'...' if len(issue_ids) > 10 else ''}"
   321→        )
   322→    parts.append("")
   323→
   324→
   325→def _append_changed_issue_section(
   326→    parts: list[str],
   327→    *,
   328→    title: str,
   329→    issue_ids: set[str],
   330→    issues: dict[str, dict] | None = None,
   331→) -> None:
   332→    if not issue_ids:
   333→        return
   334→    parts.append(f"## {title} ({len(issue_ids)})")
   335→    for issue_id in sorted(issue_ids):
   336→        if issues is None:
   337→            parts.append(f"- {issue_id}")
   338→            continue
   339→        issue = issues.get(issue_id, {})
   340→        parts.append(f"- {issue_id}: {issue.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   341→    parts.append("")
   342→
   343→
   344→def _append_resolved_issue_context(parts: list[str], resolved_issues: dict[str, dict]) -> None:
   345→    if not resolved_issues:
   346→        return
   347→    parts.append(
   348→        "## Resolved review issues available for recurrence context "
   349→        f"({len(resolved_issues)})"
   350→    )
   351→    resolved_ids = sorted(resolved_issues)
   352→    for issue_id in resolved_ids[:30]:
   353→        issue = resolved_issues.get(issue_id, {})
   354→        summary = str(issue.get("summary", "(no summary)"))
   355→        dimension = _issue_dimension(issue)
   356→        dim_suffix = f" [{dimension}]" if dimension else ""
   357→        parts.append(f"- {issue_id}{dim_suffix}: {summary}")
   358→    if len(resolved_ids) > 30:
   359→        parts.append(f"- ... and {len(resolved_ids) - 30} more resolved issues")
   360→    parts.append("")
   361→
   362→
   363→def _append_completed_clusters_section(parts: list[str], completed_clusters: list[dict]) -> None:
   364→    if not completed_clusters:
   365→        return
   366→    parts.append(
   367→        "## Completed clusters since last triage "
   368→        f"({len(completed_clusters)})"
   369→    )
   370→    completed = sorted(
   371→        completed_clusters,
   372→        key=lambda cluster: str(cluster.get("completed_at", "")),
   373→        reverse=True,
   374→    )
   375→    for cluster in completed[:10]:
   376→        name = str(cluster.get("name", "(unnamed cluster)"))
   377→        thesis = str(cluster.get("thesis") or cluster.get("description") or "")
   378→        completed_at = str(cluster.get("completed_at", ""))
   379→        issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   380→        issue_count = len(issue_ids) if isinstance(issue_ids, list) else 0
   381→        parts.append(
   382→            f"- {name}: {thesis} (issues: {issue_count}, completed_at: {completed_at})"
   383→        )
   384→    if len(completed) > 10:
   385→        parts.append(f"- ... and {len(completed) - 10} more completed clusters")
   386→    parts.append("")
   387→
   388→
   389→def _append_recurring_dimensions_section(
   390→    parts: list[str],
   391→    review_issues: dict[str, dict],
   392→    resolved_issues: dict[str, dict],
   393→) -> None:
   394→    recurring = _recurring_dimensions(review_issues, resolved_issues)
   395→    if not recurring:
   396→        return
   397→    parts.append(
   398→        "## Potential recurring dimensions (resolved issues still have open peers)"
   399→    )
   400→    for dimension, bucket in recurring.items():
   401→        open_count = len(bucket["open"])
   402→        resolved_count = len(bucket["resolved"])
   403→        parts.append(
   404→            f"- {dimension}: {open_count} open / {resolved_count} recently resolved"
   405→        )
   406→    parts.append("")
   407→
   408→
   409→def _append_open_review_issues_section(parts: list[str], review_issues: dict[str, dict]) -> None:
   410→    parts.append(f"## All open review issues ({len(review_issues)})")
   411→    for issue_id, issue in sorted(review_issues.items()):
   412→        detail = issue.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(issue.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   413→        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   414→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   415→        confidence = issue.get("confidence", "medium")
   416→        file_path = issue.get("file", "")
   417→        summary = issue.get("summary", "")
   418→        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {issue_id}")
   419→        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   420→        if dimension:
   421→            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   422→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   423→        if suggestion:
   424→            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   425→    parts.append("")
   426→
   427→
   428→def _append_dimension_scores_section(parts: list[str], dimension_scores: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   429→    if not dimension_scores:
   430→        return
   431→    parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   432→    for name, data in sorted(dimension_scores.items()):
   433→        if not isinstance(data, dict):
   434→            continue
   435→        score = data.get("score", "?")
   436→        strict = data.get("strict", score)
   437→        issues = data.get("failing", 0)
   438→        parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   439→    parts.append("")
   440→
   441→
   442→def _append_mechanical_backlog_section(
   443→    parts: list[str],
   444→    objective_backlog_issues: dict[str, dict],
   445→    auto_clusters: dict[str, dict],
   446→) -> None:
   447→    if not objective_backlog_issues:
   448→        return
   449→
   450→    clustered_ids: set[str] = set()
   451→    for cluster in auto_clusters.values():
   452→        issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   453→        if isinstance(issue_ids, list):
   454→            clustered_ids.update(
   455→                issue_id
   456→                for issue_id in issue_ids
   457→                if isinstance(issue_id, str) and issue_id in objective_backlog_issues
   458→            )
   459→
   460→    unclustered = {
   461→        issue_id: issue
   462→        for issue_id, issue in objective_backlog_issues.items()
   463→        if issue_id not in clustered_ids
   464→    }
   465→    clustered_issue_count = len(clustered_ids)
   466→    auto_cluster_count = sum(
   467→        1 for cluster in auto_clusters.values()
   468→        if any(
   469→            isinstance(issue_id, str) and issue_id in objective_backlog_issues
   470→            for issue_id in cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   471→        )
   472→    )
   473→
   474→    parts.append(
   475→        "## Mechanical backlog "
   476→        f"({len(objective_backlog_issues)} items: {clustered_issue_count} in "
   477→        f"{auto_cluster_count} auto-clusters, {len(unclustered)} unclustered)"
   478→    )
   479→    parts.append(
   480→        "These detector-created items stay in backlog unless you explicitly promote them into the active queue."
   481→    )
   482→    parts.append(
   483→        "You MUST make an explicit decision for each auto-cluster listed below. "
   484→        "Include every auto-cluster in your `auto_cluster_decisions` output with one of: "
   485→        "promote (add to active queue with a priority position), "
   486→        "skip (leave in backlog with a reason), or "
   487→        "break_up (split into smaller sub-clusters with a reason)."
   488→    )
   489→
   490→    rendered_clusters: list[tuple[str, dict, int]] = []
   491→    for name, cluster in auto_clusters.items():
   492→        raw_issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   493→        if not isinstance(raw_issue_ids, list):
   494→            continue
   495→        member_count = sum(
   496→            1 for issue_id in raw_issue_ids
   497→            if isinstance(issue_id, str) and issue_id in objective_backlog_issues
   498→        )
   499→        if member_count <= 0:
   500→            continue
   501→        rendered_clusters.append((name, cluster, member_count))
   502→
   503→    if rendered_clusters:
   504→        parts.append("### Auto-clusters (decision required for each)")
   505→        parts.append(
   506→            "These are pre-grouped detector findings. You must decide for each cluster: "
   507→            "promote (into active queue), skip (with reason), or break_up (into sub-clusters). "
   508→            "Include your decisions in the `auto_cluster_decisions` array in your response."
   509→        )
   510→        rendered_clusters.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[2], item[0]))
   511→        visible_clusters = rendered_clusters[:15]
   512→        for name, cluster, member_count in visible_clusters:
   513→            autofix_hint = _cluster_autofix_hint(cluster)
   514→            hint_suffix = f" [autofix: {autofix_hint}]" if autofix_hint else ""
   515→            summary = _cluster_backlog_summary(name, cluster, member_count)
   516→            parts.append(f"- {name} ({member_count} items){hint_suffix}")
   517→            parts.append(f"  {summary}")
   518→        if len(rendered_clusters) > len(visible_clusters):
   519→            remaining = rendered_clusters[len(visible_clusters):]
   520→            remaining_issues = sum(item[2] for item in remaining)
   521→            parts.append(
   522→                f"- ... and {len(remaining)} more clusters ({remaining_issues} issues)"
   523→            )
   524→
   525→    if unclustered:
   526→        parts.append(
   527→            f"### Unclustered items ({len(unclustered)} items — needs human judgment or isolated findings)"
   528→        )
   529→        parts.append(
   530→            "Promote individually with `desloppify plan promote <issue-id>`, or group related items into a manual cluster."
   531→        )
   532→        sample_ids = sorted(
   533→            unclustered,
   534→            key=lambda issue_id: (
   535→                _confidence_sort_key(unclustered[issue_id]),
   536→                issue_id,
   537→            ),
   538→        )[:10]
   539→        for issue_id in sample_ids:
   540→            issue = unclustered[issue_id]
   541→            confidence = str(issue.get("confidence", "medium"))
   542→            summary = str(issue.get("summary", "(no summary)"))
   543→            parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {issue_id} — {summary}")
   544→        if len(unclustered) > len(sample_ids):
   545→            parts.append(
   546→                f"- ... and {len(unclustered) - len(sample_ids)} more unclustered items"
   547→            )
   548→
   549→    parts.append("Browse full backlog: `desloppify backlog`")
   550→    parts.append("Inspect a cluster: `desloppify plan cluster show auto/<name>`")
   551→    parts.append("Inspect an issue: `desloppify show <issue-id>`")
   552→    parts.append("")
   553→
   554→
   555→def _cluster_autofix_hint(cluster: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
   556→    return cluster_autofix_hint(cluster) or ""
   557→
   558→
   559→def _cluster_backlog_summary(name: str, cluster: dict[str, Any], member_count: int) -> str:
   560→    description = str(cluster.get("description") or "").strip()
   561→    if description:
   562→        return description
   563→    title = name.removeprefix("auto/").replace("-", " ")
   564→    if title:
   565→        return f"Address {member_count} {title} findings"
   566→    return f"Address {member_count} detector findings"
   567→
   568→
   569→def _confidence_sort_key(issue: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
   570→    confidence = str(issue.get("confidence", "medium")).lower()
   571→    order = {"high": 0, "medium": 1, "low": 2}
   572→    return order.get(confidence, 1)
   573→
   574→
   575→def _append_previously_dismissed_section(parts: list[str], dismissed_ids: list[str]) -> None:
   576→    if not dismissed_ids:
   577→        return
   578→    parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(dismissed_ids)})")
   579→    parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   580→    for issue_id in dismissed_ids:
   581→        parts.append(f"- {issue_id}")
   582→    parts.append("")
   583→
   584→
   585→def build_triage_prompt(si: TriageInput) -> str:
   586→    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all issue data."""
   587→    parts: list[str] = []
   588→    _append_existing_clusters_section(parts, si.existing_clusters)
   589→    _append_changed_issue_section(
   590→        parts,
   591→        title="New issues since last triage",
   592→        issue_ids=si.new_since_last,
   593→        issues=si.review_issues,
   594→    )
   595→    _append_changed_issue_section(
   596→        parts,
   597→        title="Resolved since last triage",
   598→        issue_ids=si.resolved_since_last,
   599→    )
   600→    _append_resolved_issue_context(parts, si.resolved_issues)
   601→    _append_completed_clusters_section(parts, si.completed_clusters)
   602→    _append_recurring_dimensions_section(parts, si.review_issues, si.resolved_issues)
   603→    _append_open_review_issues_section(parts, si.review_issues)
   604→    _append_dimension_scores_section(parts, si.dimension_scores)
   605→    _append_mechanical_backlog_section(
   606→        parts,
   607→        si.objective_backlog_issues,
   608→        si.auto_clusters,
   609→    )
   610→    _append_previously_dismissed_section(parts, si.previously_dismissed)
   611→    return "\n".join(parts)
   612→
   613→__all__ = [
   614→    "_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT",
   615→    "AutoClusterDecision",
   616→    "ContradictionNote",
   617→    "DismissedIssue",
   618→    "TriageInput",
   619→    "TriageResult",
   620→    "build_triage_prompt",
   621→    "collect_triage_input",
   622→]

    21→def new_item_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:

    23→    scan_history = state.get("scan_history", [])

    26→    threshold = scan_history[-1].get("timestamp", "")
    27→    if not threshold:

    30→        issue_id
    31→        for issue_id, issue in (state.get("work_items") or state.get("issues", {})).items()

    33→    }

    36→def enrich_plan_metadata(items: list[WorkQueueItem], plan: dict) -> None:

    49→        if override.get("cluster"):
    50→            cluster_name = override["cluster"]

    91→    Returns ``(non_skipped, skipped)`` so callers can optionally re-append.
    92→    """
    93→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
    94→    if not skipped_ids:
    95→        return items, []
    96→    non_skipped: list[WorkQueueItem] = []
    97→    skipped: list[WorkQueueItem] = []
    98→    for item in items:
    99→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
   100→            skipped.append(item)
   101→        else:
   102→            non_skipped.append(item)
   103→    return non_skipped, skipped
   104→
   105→
   106→def filter_cluster_focus(
   107→    items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   108→    plan: dict,
   109→    cluster: str | None,
   110→) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   111→    """Filter to only cluster members when a cluster focus is active."""
   112→    effective_cluster = cluster or plan.get("active_cluster")
   113→    if not effective_cluster:
   114→        return items
   115→    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
   116→    cluster_data = clusters.get(effective_cluster, {})
   117→    cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_issue_ids(cluster_data))
   118→    if not cluster_member_ids:
   119→        return items
   120→    return [item for item in items if item["id"] in cluster_member_ids]
   121→
   122→
   123→def stamp_positions(items: list[WorkQueueItem], plan: dict) -> None:
   124→    """Stamp queue_position and plan_skipped metadata on each item."""
   125→    skipped_map: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
   126→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(skipped_map.keys())
   127→
   128→    for position, item in enumerate(items):
   129→        item["queue_position"] = position + 1
   130→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
   131→            item["plan_skipped"] = True
   132→            skip_entry = skipped_map.get(item["id"])
   133→            if skip_entry:
   134→                item["plan_skip_kind"] = skip_entry.get("kind", "temporary")
   135→                skip_reason = skip_entry.get("reason")
   136→                if skip_reason:
   137→                    item["plan_skip_reason"] = skip_reason
   138→
   139→
   140→def _build_cluster_meta(
   141→    cluster_name: str, members: list[WorkQueueItem], cluster_data: dict[str, Any]
   142→) -> WorkQueueItem:
   143→    """Build a cluster meta-item from its member items."""
   144→    detector = members[0].get("detector", "") if members else ""
   145→    action_type = infer_cluster_action_type(cluster_data, detector=detector)
   146→
   147→    stored_desc = cluster_data.get("description") or ""
   148→    total_in_cluster = len(cluster_issue_ids(cluster_data))
   149→    if stored_desc and total_in_cluster != len(members):
   150→        summary = stored_desc.replace(str(total_in_cluster), str(len(members)))
   151→    else:
   152→        summary = stored_desc or f"{len(members)} issues"
   153→
   154→    action = cluster_data.get("action") or ""
   155→    autofix_hint = cluster_autofix_hint(cluster_data, detector=detector)
   156→    if autofix_hint:
   157→        primary_command = f"desloppify next --cluster {cluster_name} --count 10"
   158→    else:
   159→        primary_command = action or f"desloppify next --cluster {cluster_name} --count 10"
   160→
   161→    estimated_impact = max(
   162→        (m.get("estimated_impact", 0.0) for m in members), default=0.0
   163→    )
   164→
   165→    return {
   166→        "id": cluster_name,
   167→        "kind": "cluster",
   168→        "action_type": action_type,
   169→        "summary": summary,
   170→        "members": members,
   171→        "member_count": len(members),
   172→        "primary_command": primary_command,
   173→        "autofix_hint": autofix_hint,
   174→        "cluster_name": cluster_name,
   175→        "cluster_auto": bool(cluster_data.get("auto")),
   176→        "cluster_optional": bool(cluster_data.get("optional")),
   177→        "execution_policy": infer_cluster_execution_policy(
   178→            cluster_data,
   179→            detector=detector,
   180→        ),
   181→        "execution_status": cluster_data.get("execution_status", "review"),
   182→        "confidence": "high",
   183→        "detector": detector,
   184→        "file": "",
   185→        "estimated_impact": estimated_impact,
   186→        "action_steps": cluster_data.get("action_steps") or [],
   187→    }
   188→
   189→
   190→def collapse_clusters(items: list[WorkQueueItem], plan: dict) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   191→    """Replace cluster member items with single cluster meta-items.
   192→
   193→    Both auto-clusters and manual (triage) clusters are collapsed.  Manual
   194→    clusters are inserted at the front in plan order so triage-prioritised
   195→    work appears before auto-clustered mechanical items.
   196→    """
   197→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   198→    if not clusters:
   199→        return items
   200→
   201→    fid_to_cluster: dict[str, str] = {}
   202→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
   203→        for issue_id in cluster_issue_ids(cluster):
   204→            # Manual clusters take priority when an issue is in both
   205→            if issue_id not in fid_to_cluster or not cluster.get("auto"):
   206→                fid_to_cluster[issue_id] = name
   207→
   208→    if not fid_to_cluster:
   209→        return items
   210→
   211→    # Collect members per cluster (preserving encounter order)
   212→    cluster_members: dict[str, list[WorkQueueItem]] = {}
   213→    for item in items:
   214→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   215→        if cname:
   216→            cluster_members.setdefault(cname, []).append(item)
   217→
   218→    # Build meta-items only for clusters with 2+ members in the queue
   219→    meta_items: dict[str, WorkQueueItem] = {}
   220→    for cname, members in cluster_members.items():
   221→        if len(members) < 2:
   222→            continue
   223→        meta_items[cname] = _build_cluster_meta(
   224→            cname, members, clusters.get(cname, {})
   225→        )
   226→
   227→    # Collect manual cluster names in plan order (for front-insertion)
   228→    manual_names = [
   229→        name for name in clusters
   230→        if not clusters[name].get("auto") and name in meta_items
   231→    ]
   232→
   233→    # Walk in order: replace first auto-cluster member with meta-item,
   234→    # skip subsequent members.  Manual cluster members are always skipped
   235→    # (they'll be inserted at the front).
   236→    seen_clusters: set[str] = set()
   237→    rest: list[WorkQueueItem] = []
   238→    for item in items:
   239→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   240→        if cname and cname in meta_items:
   241→            if cname not in seen_clusters:
   242→                seen_clusters.add(cname)
   243→                # Auto-clusters collapse in-place; manual clusters go to front
   244→                if clusters.get(cname, {}).get("auto"):
   245→                    rest.append(meta_items[cname])
   246→            # skip individual member
   247→        else:
   248→            rest.append(item)
   249→
   250→    # Manual clusters at the front in plan order, then everything else
   251→    manual_result = [meta_items[name] for name in manual_names if name in seen_clusters]
   252→    return manual_result + rest
   253→
   254→
   255→__all__ = [
   256→    "collapse_clusters",
   257→    "enrich_plan_metadata",
   258→    "filter_cluster_focus",
   259→    "new_item_ids",
   260→    "separate_skipped",
   261→    "stamp_plan_sort_keys",
   262→    "stamp_positions",
   263→]
   264→

    21→def cmd_autofix(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:

    40→    total_items = sum(len(r["removed"]) for r in results)
    41→    total_lines = sum(r.get("lines_removed", 0) for r in results)
    42→    _print_fix_summary(fixer, results, total_items, total_lines, dry_run)

    44→    if dry_run and results:

    46→
    47→    if not dry_run:

   277→        " plan --help` to see all available plan tools. Otherwise"
   278→        " no need to reply, just keep going."
   279→    )
   280→    if transition_phase:
   281→        emit_transition_message(transition_phase)
   282→
   283→
   284→def cmd_plan_unskip(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   285→    """Unskip issues — bring back to queue."""
   286→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   287→    state = runtime.state
   288→    if not require_issue_inventory(state):
   289→        return
   290→
   291→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   292→
   293→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   294→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)
   295→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
   296→    issue_ids = resolve_ids_from_patterns(state, patterns, plan=plan, status_filter="all")
   297→    if not issue_ids:
   298→        print(colorize("  No matching issues found.", "yellow"))
   299→        return
   300→
   301→    include_protected = bool(getattr(args, "force", False))
   302→    count, need_reopen, protected_kept = unskip_items(
   303→        plan,
   304→        issue_ids,
   305→        include_protected=include_protected,
   306→    )
   307→    unskipped_ids = [fid for fid in issue_ids if fid not in protected_kept]
   308→    append_log_entry(
   309→        plan,
   310→        "unskip",
   311→        issue_ids=unskipped_ids,
   312→        actor="user",
   313→        detail={"need_reopen": need_reopen},
   314→    )
   315→    transition_phase: str | None = None
   316→    if clear_postflight_scan_completion(plan, issue_ids=unskipped_ids, state=state):
   317→        transition_phase = LIFECYCLE_PHASE_EXECUTE
   318→
   319→    reopened: list[str] = []
   320→    if need_reopen:
   321→        state_data = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   322→        for fid in need_reopen:
   323→            reopened.extend(state_mod.resolve_issues(state_data, fid, "open"))
   324→        save_plan_state_transactional(
   325→            plan=plan,
   326→            plan_path=plan_file,
   327→            state_data=state_data,
   328→            state_path_value=state_file,
   329→        )
   330→        print(colorize(f"  Reopened {len(reopened)} issue(s) in state.", "dim"))
   331→    else:
   332→        save_plan(plan, plan_file)
   333→
   334→    print(colorize(f"  Unskipped {count} item(s) — back in queue.", "green"))
   335→    if protected_kept:
   336→        print(
   337→            colorize(
   338→                f"  Kept {len(protected_kept)} protected skip(s) "
   339→                f"(permanent/false_positive with notes). Use --force to override.",
   340→                "yellow",
   341→            )
   342→        )
   343→    if transition_phase:
   344→        emit_transition_message(transition_phase)
   345→
   346→
   347→def cmd_plan_backlog(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   348→    """Move deferred items to backlog — remove from plan tracking entirely."""
   349→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   350→    state = runtime.state
   351→    if not require_issue_inventory(state):
   352→        return
   353→
   354→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   355→
   356→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   357→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)
   358→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
   359→    issue_ids = resolve_ids_from_patterns(state, patterns, plan=plan, status_filter="all")
   360→    if not issue_ids:
   361→        print(colorize("  No matching issues found.", "yellow"))
   362→        return
   363→
   364→    removed = backlog_items(plan, issue_ids)
   365→    if not removed:
   366→        print(colorize("  No matching deferred items found.", "yellow"))
   367→        return
   368→
   369→    # Reopen issues whose state status was set by the skip (deferred/triaged_out)
   370→    # so they don't get stranded with a non-open status while untracked by plan.
   371→    _BACKLOG_REOPEN_STATUSES = {"deferred", "triaged_out"}
   372→    state_data = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   373→    issues = state_data.get("work_items", {})
   374→    reopen_ids = [
   375→        fid for fid in removed
   376→        if issues.get(fid, {}).get("status") in _BACKLOG_REOPEN_STATUSES
   377→    ]
   378→
   379→    if reopen_ids:
   380→        for fid in reopen_ids:
   381→            state_mod.resolve_issues(state_data, fid, "open")
   382→
   383→    append_log_entry(
   384→        plan,
   385→        "backlog",
   386→        issue_ids=removed,
   387→        actor="user",
   388→    )
   389→    transition_phase: str | None = None
   390→    if clear_postflight_scan_completion(plan, issue_ids=removed, state=state_data):
   391→        transition_phase = LIFECYCLE_PHASE_EXECUTE
   392→
   393→    if reopen_ids:
   394→        save_plan_state_transactional(
   395→            plan=plan,
   396→            plan_path=plan_file,
   397→            state_data=state_data,
   398→            state_path_value=state_file,
   399→        )
   400→    else:
   401→        save_plan(plan, plan_file)
   402→
   403→    print(colorize(f"  Moved {len(removed)} item(s) to backlog.", "green"))
   404→    if reopen_ids:
   405→        print(colorize(f"  Reopened {len(reopen_ids)} deferred/triaged-out issue(s) in state.", "dim"))
   406→    if transition_phase:
   407→        emit_transition_message(transition_phase)
   408→
   409→

   413→    "cmd_plan_backlog",

    20→
    21→def check_cluster_guard(patterns: list[str], plan: dict, state: dict) -> bool:
    22→    """Return True if blocked by cluster guard, False if OK to proceed."""
    23→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
    24→    issues = (state.get("work_items") or state.get("issues", {}))
    25→    for pattern in patterns:
    26→        if pattern in clusters:
    27→            cluster = clusters[pattern]
    28→            issue_ids = [
    29→                issue_id
    30→                for issue_id in cluster_issue_ids(cluster)
    31→                if issue_id in issues and issues[issue_id].get("status") == "open"
    32→            ]
    33→            if len(issue_ids) == 0:
    34→                print(
    35→                    colorize(
    36→                        f"\n  Cluster '{pattern}' is empty — add items before marking it done.\n",
    37→                        "yellow",
    38→                    )
    39→                )
    40→                print(colorize(f"  Use: desloppify plan cluster add {pattern} <issue-id>", "dim"))
    41→                return True
    42→            if len(issue_ids) <= _CLUSTER_INDIVIDUAL_THRESHOLD:
    43→                print_cluster_guard(pattern, issue_ids, state)
    44→                return True
    45→    return False
    46→
    47→
    48→def print_cluster_guard(cluster_name: str, issue_ids: list[str], state: dict) -> None:
    49→    issues = (state.get("work_items") or state.get("issues", {}))
    50→    print(
    51→        colorize(
    52→            f"\n  Cluster '{cluster_name}' has {len(issue_ids)} item(s) — mark them done individually first:\n",
    53→            "yellow",
    54→        )
    55→    )
    56→    for issue_id in issue_ids:
    57→        issue = issues.get(issue_id, {})
    58→        summary = issue.get("summary", "(no summary)")[:80]
    59→        detector = issue.get("detector", "?")
    60→        print(f"    {issue_id}  [{detector}]  {summary}")
    61→    print(
    62→        colorize(
    63→            "\n  Use: desloppify plan resolve <id> --status fixed --note '...' --attest '...'",
    64→            "dim",
    65→        )
    66→    )
    67→    print(
    68→        colorize(
    69→            "  Or mark each resolved: desloppify plan resolve <id> --note '...' --confirm\n",
    70→            "dim",
    71→        )
    72→    )
    73→def split_synthetic_patterns(patterns: list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    74→    """Partition synthetic workflow/triage patterns from real issue patterns."""
    75→    synthetic = [pattern for pattern in patterns if is_synthetic_id(pattern)]
    76→    remaining = [pattern for pattern in patterns if not is_synthetic_id(pattern)]
    77→    return synthetic, remaining
    78→
    79→
    80→def resolve_synthetic_ids(patterns: list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    81→    """Compatibility alias for older call sites."""
    82→    return split_synthetic_patterns(patterns)
    83→
    84→
    85→def blocked_triage_stages(plan: dict) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    86→    """Return triage stages that are blocked by unmet dependencies."""
    87→    order_set = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
    88→    stage_names = (
    89→        "observe",
    90→        "reflect",
    91→        "organize",
    92→        "enrich",
    93→        "sense-check",
    94→        "commit",
    95→    )
    96→    present_names = {
    97→        name
    98→        for stage_id, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names, strict=False)
    99→        if stage_id in (order_set & TRIAGE_IDS)
   100→    }
   101→    present_names.update(recorded_unconfirmed_triage_stage_names(plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})))
   102→    if not present_names:
   103→        return {}
   104→
   105→    confirmed = confirmed_triage_stage_names(plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {}))
   106→
   107→    blocked: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   108→    for stage_id, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names, strict=False):
   109→        if name not in present_names or name in confirmed:
   110→            continue
   111→        unmet = [
   112→            prerequisite.stage_name
   113→            for prerequisite in TRIAGE_STAGE_PREREQUISITES.get(name, ())
   114→            if prerequisite.stage_name in present_names and prerequisite.stage_name not in confirmed
   115→        ]
   116→        if unmet:
   117→            blocked[stage_id] = [f"triage::{unmet[-1]}"]
   118→    return blocked
   119→
   120→

1→"""Queue item selection from canonical snapshot or raw issue lists."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import scope_matches
     6→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.inputs import gather_subjective_items
     7→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.models import QueueBuildOptions, QueueVisibility
     8→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.ranking import build_issue_items
     9→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.snapshot import build_queue_snapshot
    10→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.types import WorkQueueItem
    11→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    12→
    13→
    14→def select_queue_items(
    15→    state: StateModel,
    16→    *,
    17→    opts: QueueBuildOptions,
    18→    plan: dict | None,
    19→    scan_path: str | None,
    20→    status: str,
    21→    threshold: float,
    22→    visibility: str,
    23→) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
    24→    """Select the raw queue item list before ranking/finalization."""
    25→    if status == "open" and not opts.chronic:
    26→        snapshot = build_queue_snapshot(
    27→            state,
    28→            options=opts,
    29→            plan=plan,
    30→            target_strict=threshold,
    31→        )
    32→        return filter_snapshot_items(
    33→            items_for_visibility(snapshot=snapshot, visibility=visibility),
    34→            opts,
    35→        )
    36→
    37→    items = build_issue_items(
    38→        state,
    39→        scan_path=scan_path,
    40→        status_filter=status,
    41→        scope=opts.scope,
    42→        chronic=opts.chronic,
    43→    )
    44→    if opts.include_subjective and status == "all":
    45→        items += gather_subjective_items(state, opts, threshold)
    46→    return items
    47→
    48→
    49→def items_for_visibility(*, snapshot, visibility: str) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
    50→    """Select the snapshot partition for one queue surface."""
    51→    if visibility == QueueVisibility.BACKLOG:
    52→        source_items = snapshot.backlog_items or snapshot.execution_items
    53→        return [
    54→            dict(item)
    55→            for item in source_items
    56→            if item.get("kind") not in {"workflow_stage", "workflow_action"}
    57→        ]
    58→    return [dict(item) for item in snapshot.execution_items]
    59→
    60→
    61→def filter_snapshot_items(
    62→    items: list[WorkQueueItem],
    63→    opts: QueueBuildOptions,
    64→) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
    65→    """Apply view-local filtering after snapshot partition selection."""
    66→    filtered = items
    67→    if not opts.include_subjective:
    68→        filtered = [
    69→            item for item in filtered
    70→            if item.get("kind") != "subjective_dimension"
    71→        ]
    72→    if opts.scope:
    73→        filtered = [
    74→            item for item in filtered
    75→            if item.get("kind") != "subjective_dimension" or scope_matches(item, opts.scope)
    76→        ]
    77→    return filtered
    78→
    79→
    80→__all__ = [
    81→    "filter_snapshot_items",
    82→    "items_for_visibility",
    83→    "select_queue_items",
    84→]

   194→        command_name=command_name,
   195→    )
   196→
   197→
   198→def _render_terminal_queue_view(
   199→    *,
   200→    queue: dict,
   201→    items: list[dict],
   202→    state: dict,
   203→    opts: NextOptions,
   204→    plan_for_queue: dict,
   205→    plan_data: dict | None,
   206→    effective_cluster: str | None,
   207→    target_strict: float,
   208→    ctx,
   209→    show_plan_context: bool,
   210→    show_execution_prompt: bool,
   211→) -> None:
   212→    """Render terminal output for a non-empty queue."""
   213→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {})
   214→    issues_scoped = path_scoped_issues(
   215→        (state.get("work_items") or state.get("issues", {})),
   216→        state.get("scan_path"),
   217→    )
   218→    plan_start_strict = None
   219→    breakdown = None
   220→    if show_plan_context:
   221→        plan_start_strict, breakdown = _plan_queue_context(
   222→            state=state,
   223→            plan_data=plan_for_queue,
   224→            context=ctx,
   225→        )
   226→    queue_total = breakdown.queue_total if breakdown else 0
   227→
   228→    _render_queue_header(queue, opts.explain)
   229→    strict_score = score_snapshot(state).strict
   230→    if _show_empty_queue(
   231→        queue,
   232→        strict_score,
   233→        plan_start_strict=plan_start_strict,
   234→        target_strict=target_strict,
   235→    ):
   236→        return
   237→
   238→    potentials = _merge_potentials_safe(state.get("potentials", {}))
   239→    next_render_mod.render_terminal_items(
   240→        items,
   241→        dim_scores,
   242→        issues_scoped,
   243→        group=opts.group,
   244→        explain=opts.explain,
   245→        potentials=potentials,
   246→        plan=plan_data,
   247→        cluster_filter=effective_cluster,
   248→    )
   249→    next_nudges_mod.render_single_item_resolution_hint(items)
   250→    if show_plan_context:
   251→        next_nudges_mod.render_uncommitted_reminder(plan_data)
   252→        next_nudges_mod.render_followup_nudges(
   253→            state,
   254→            dim_scores,
   255→            issues_scoped,
   256→            strict_score=strict_score,
   257→            target_strict_score=target_strict,
   258→            queue_total=queue_total,
   259→            plan_start_strict=plan_start_strict,
   260→            breakdown=breakdown,
   261→        )
   262→    print()
   263→
   264→    if items and plan_data and show_execution_prompt:
   265→        print_user_message(
   266→            "Start working on the task above. When done:"
   267→            " `desloppify plan resolve`. Full queue:"
   268→            " `desloppify plan show`."
   269→        )
   270→
   271→
   272→def _plan_data_for_view(plan: dict, *, show_plan_context: bool) -> dict | None:
   273→    if not show_plan_context:
   274→        return None
   275→    if plan.get("queue_order") or plan.get("overrides") or plan.get("clusters"):
   276→        return plan
   277→    return None
   278→
   279→
   280→def _resolve_queue_items(
   281→    *,
   282→    state: dict,
   283→    config: dict,
   284→    opts: NextOptions,
   285→    plan_for_queue: dict,
   286→    target_strict: float,
   287→    build_work_queue_fn,
   288→) -> tuple[object, dict, list[dict], str | None]:
   289→    ctx = queue_context(
   290→        state,
   291→        target_strict=target_strict,
   292→        config=config,
   293→        plan=plan_for_queue,
   294→    )
   295→    effective_cluster = _resolve_cluster_focus(
   296→        plan_for_queue,
   297→        cluster_arg=opts.cluster,
   298→        scope=opts.scope,
   299→    )
   300→    queue = build_work_queue_fn(
   301→        state,
   302→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
   303→            count=None,
   304→            scope=opts.scope,
   305→            status=opts.status,
   306→            include_subjective=True,
   307→            subjective_threshold=target_strict,
   308→            explain=opts.explain,
   309→            include_skipped=opts.include_skipped,
   310→            context=ctx,
   311→        ),
   312→    )
   313→    return ctx, queue, queue.get("items", []), effective_cluster
   314→
   315→
   316→def _apply_queue_view_transforms(
   317→    *,
   318→    items: list[dict],
   319→    queue: dict,
   320→    opts: NextOptions,
   321→    plan_for_queue: dict,
   322→    effective_cluster: str | None,
   323→    collapse_plan_clusters: bool,
   324→) -> list[dict]:
   325→    visible = items
   326→    if collapse_plan_clusters and effective_cluster and plan_for_queue:
   327→        visible = filter_cluster_focus(visible, plan_for_queue, effective_cluster)
   328→    elif (
   329→        collapse_plan_clusters
   330→        and plan_for_queue
   331→        and not effective_cluster
   332→        and not plan_for_queue.get("active_cluster")
   333→    ):
   334→        visible = collapse_clusters(visible, plan_for_queue)
   335→
   336→    if opts.count:
   337→        visible = visible[: opts.count]
   338→        queue["items"] = visible
   339→        queue["total"] = len(visible)
   340→    return visible
   341→
   342→
   343→def _render_non_empty_queue(
   344→    *,
   345→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   346→    state: dict,
   347→    items: list[dict],
   348→    queue: dict,
   349→    plan_data: dict | None,
   350→    guardrail_warnings: list[str],
   351→    write_query_fn,
   352→    view: QueueViewConfig,
   353→    opts: NextOptions,
   354→    plan_for_queue: dict,
   355→    effective_cluster: str | None,
   356→    target_strict: float,
   357→    ctx,
   358→    resolve_lang_fn,
   359→) -> None:
   360→    lang = resolve_lang_fn(args)
   361→    lang_name = lang.name if lang else None
   362→    narrative = compute_narrative(
   363→        state,
   364→        context=NarrativeContext(lang=lang_name, command=view.command_name, plan=plan_data),
   365→    )
   366→    payload = _write_next_payload(
   367→        queue=queue,
   368→        items=items,
   369→        state=state,
   370→        narrative=narrative,
   371→        plan_data=plan_data,
   372→        guardrail_warnings=guardrail_warnings,
   373→        write_query_fn=write_query_fn,
   374→        command_name=view.command_name,
   375→    )
   376→
   377→    if _emit_requested_output(opts, payload, items, command_name=view.command_name):
   378→        return
   379→
   380→    _render_terminal_queue_view(
   381→        queue=queue,
   382→        items=items,
   383→        state=state,
   384→        opts=opts,
   385→        plan_for_queue=plan_for_queue,
   386→        plan_data=plan_data,
   387→        effective_cluster=effective_cluster,
   388→        target_strict=target_strict,
   389→        ctx=ctx,
   390→        show_plan_context=view.show_plan_context,
   391→        show_execution_prompt=view.show_execution_prompt,
   392→    )
   393→
   394→
   395→def _build_and_render_queue_view(
   396→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   397→    state: dict,
   398→    config: dict,
   399→    *,
   400→    deps: QueueRenderDeps,
   401→    view: QueueViewConfig,
   402→) -> None:
   403→    """Build queue payload and render output for a queue surface."""
   404→    opts = NextOptions.from_args(args)
   405→    guardrail_warnings = triage_guardrail_messages(state=state)
   406→    target_strict = target_strict_score_from_config(config)
   407→
   408→    plan = deps.load_plan_fn()
   409→    plan_for_queue = plan
   410→    plan_data = _plan_data_for_view(plan, show_plan_context=view.show_plan_context)
   411→    ctx, queue, items, effective_cluster = _resolve_queue_items(
   412→        state=state,
   413→        config=config,
   414→        opts=opts,
   415→        plan_for_queue=plan_for_queue,
   416→        target_strict=target_strict,
   417→        build_work_queue_fn=deps.build_work_queue_fn,
   418→    )
   419→    items = _apply_queue_view_transforms(
   420→        items=items,
   421→        queue=queue,
   422→        opts=opts,
   423→        plan_for_queue=plan_for_queue,
   424→        effective_cluster=effective_cluster,
   425→        collapse_plan_clusters=view.collapse_plan_clusters,
   426→    )
   427→
   428→    if not items:
   429→        _render_empty_queue_view(
   430→            queue=queue,
   431→            items=items,
   432→            state=state,
   433→            plan_for_queue=plan_for_queue,
   434→            plan_data=plan_data,
   435→            ctx=ctx,
   436→            target_strict=target_strict,
   437→            opts=opts,
   438→            guardrail_warnings=guardrail_warnings,
   439→            write_query_fn=deps.write_query_fn,
   440→            command_name=view.command_name,
   441→            show_plan_context=view.show_plan_context,
   442→        )
   443→        return
   444→
   445→    _render_non_empty_queue(
   446→        args=args,
   447→        state=state,
   448→        items=items,
   449→        queue=queue,
   450→        plan_data=plan_data,
   451→        guardrail_warnings=guardrail_warnings,
   452→        write_query_fn=deps.write_query_fn,
   453→        view=view,
   454→        opts=opts,
   455→        plan_for_queue=plan_for_queue,
   456→        effective_cluster=effective_cluster,
   457→        target_strict=target_strict,
   458→        ctx=ctx,
   459→        resolve_lang_fn=deps.resolve_lang_fn,
   460→    )
   461→
   462→
   463→def build_and_render_execution_queue(
   464→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   465→    state: dict,
   466→    config: dict,
   467→    *,
   468→    deps: QueueRenderDeps | None = None,
   469→) -> None:
   470→    """Build queue payload and render output for `desloppify next`."""
   471→    build_and_render_queue(
   472→        args,
   473→        state,
   474→        config,
   475→        view=EXECUTION_QUEUE_VIEW,
   476→        deps=deps
   477→        or QueueRenderDeps(
   478→            build_work_queue_fn=build_execution_queue,
   479→        ),
   480→    )
   481→
   482→
   483→def build_and_render_backlog_queue(
   484→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   485→    state: dict,
   486→    config: dict,
   487→    *,
   488→    deps: QueueRenderDeps | None = None,
   489→) -> None:
   490→    """Build queue payload and render output for `desloppify backlog`."""
   491→    build_and_render_queue(
   492→        args,
   493→        state,
   494→        config,
   495→        view=BACKLOG_QUEUE_VIEW,
   496→        deps=deps
   497→        or QueueRenderDeps(
   498→            build_work_queue_fn=build_backlog_queue,
   499→        ),
   500→    )
   501→
   502→
   503→def build_and_render_queue(
   504→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   505→    state: dict,
   506→    config: dict,
   507→    *,
   508→    view: QueueViewConfig = EXECUTION_QUEUE_VIEW,
   509→    deps: QueueRenderDeps | None = None,
   510→) -> None:
   511→    """Build queue payload and render output using one stable view contract."""
   512→    _build_and_render_queue_view(
   513→        args,
   514→        state,
   515→        config,
   516→        deps=deps or QueueRenderDeps(build_work_queue_fn=build_execution_queue),
   517→        view=view,
   518→    )

   529→]

   111→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   112→# Internal helpers — option resolution, item classification
   113→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   114→
   115→def _option_value(options: object | None, name: str, default: Any) -> Any:
   116→    if options is None:
   117→        return default
   118→    return getattr(options, name, default)
   119→
   120→
   121→def _resolved_scan_path(options: object | None, state: StateModel) -> str | None:
   122→    scan_path = _option_value(options, "scan_path", state.get("scan_path"))
   123→    if hasattr(scan_path, "__class__") and scan_path.__class__.__name__ == "_ScanPathFromState":
   124→        return state.get("scan_path")
   125→    return scan_path
   126→
   127→
   128→def _is_fresh_boundary(plan: dict | None) -> bool:
   129→    if not isinstance(plan, dict):
   130→        return True
   131→    scores = plan.get("plan_start_scores")
   132→    if not scores:
   133→        return True
   134→    return isinstance(scores, dict) and bool(scores.get("reset"))
   135→
   136→
   137→def _is_objective_item(item: WorkQueueItem, *, skipped_ids: set[str]) -> bool:
   138→    return (
   139→        item.get("kind") in {"issue", "cluster"}
   140→        and counts_toward_objective_backlog(item)
   141→        and item.get("id", "") not in skipped_ids
   142→    )
   143→
   144→
   145→def _review_issue_items(items: Iterable[WorkQueueItem]) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   146→    return [
   147→        item for item in items
   148→        if is_triage_finding(item)
   149→    ]
   150→
   151→
   152→def _assessment_request_items(items: Iterable[WorkQueueItem]) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   153→    return [
   154→        item for item in items
   155→        if is_assessment_request(item)
   156→    ]
   157→
   158→
   159→def _active_cluster_issue_ids(plan: dict | None) -> set[str]:
   160→    """Return issue IDs owned by clusters that are active planned work."""
   161→    if not isinstance(plan, dict):
   162→        return set()
   163→    active_ids: set[str] = set()
   164→    skipped_ids = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   165→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   166→        if not isinstance(cluster, dict) or not cluster_is_active(cluster):
   167→            continue
   168→        for issue_id in cluster.get("issue_ids", []):
   169→            if isinstance(issue_id, str) and issue_id and issue_id not in skipped_ids:
   170→                active_ids.add(issue_id)
   171→    return active_ids
   172→
   173→
   174→def _all_cluster_issue_ids(plan: dict | None) -> set[str]:
   175→    """Return issue IDs owned by any cluster (regardless of status)."""
   176→    if not isinstance(plan, dict):
   177→        return set()
   178→    all_ids: set[str] = set()
   179→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   180→        if not isinstance(cluster, dict):
   181→            continue
   182→        for issue_id in cluster.get("issue_ids", []):
   183→            if isinstance(issue_id, str) and issue_id:
   184→                all_ids.add(issue_id)
   185→    return all_ids
   186→
   187→
   188→def _merge_execution_candidates(
   189→    *,
   190→    all_issue_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   191→    explicit_objective_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   192→    plan: dict | None,
   193→    review_issue_ids: set[str],
   194→    assessment_request_ids: set[str],
   195→) -> tuple[list[WorkQueueItem], list[WorkQueueItem]]:
   196→    """Merge queue-owned execution items with objective defaults."""
   197→    explicit_queue_ids = _live_planned_queue_ids(plan)
   198→    active_cluster_ids = _active_cluster_issue_ids(plan)
   199→
   200→    queued_non_review_items = [
   201→        item
   202→        for item in all_issue_items
   203→        if item.get("id", "") in explicit_queue_ids
   204→        and item.get("id", "") not in assessment_request_ids
   205→        and (
   206→            item.get("id", "") not in review_issue_ids
   207→            or item.get("id", "") in active_cluster_ids
   208→        )
   209→    ]
   210→
   211→    execution_candidates: list[WorkQueueItem] = []
   212→    seen_execution_ids: set[str] = set()
   213→    for item in [*explicit_objective_items, *queued_non_review_items]:
   214→        item_id = str(item.get("id", ""))
   215→        if not item_id or item_id in seen_execution_ids:
   216→            continue
   217→        seen_execution_ids.add(item_id)
   218→        execution_candidates.append(item)
   219→
   220→    anchored_execution_items = [
   221→        item
   222→        for item in execution_candidates
   223→        if item.get("id", "") in explicit_queue_ids
   224→    ]
   225→    return execution_candidates, anchored_execution_items

   228→def _executable_review_issue_items(
   229→    plan: dict | None,
   230→    state: StateModel,
   231→    review_issue_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   232→) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   233→    """Hide raw review findings until triage is current for the live issue set."""
   234→    if not review_issue_items or not isinstance(plan, dict):
   235→        return review_issue_items
   236→
   237→    triage_snapshot = build_triage_snapshot(plan, state)
   238→    if triage_snapshot.has_triage_in_queue:
   239→        return []
   240→    if triage_snapshot.is_triage_stale:
   241→        return []
   242→    if not triage_snapshot.triage_has_run:
   243→        return []
   244→    return review_issue_items
   245→
   246→
   247→def _subjective_partitions(
   248→    state: StateModel,
   249→    *,
   250→    scoped_issues: dict[str, dict],
   251→    threshold: float,
   252→    plan: dict | None,
   253→) -> tuple[list[WorkQueueItem], list[WorkQueueItem]]:
   254→    candidates = build_subjective_items(state, scoped_issues, threshold=threshold, plan=plan)
   255→    initial = [item for item in candidates if item.get("initial_review")]
   256→    postflight = [item for item in candidates if not item.get("initial_review")]
   257→    return initial, postflight
   258→
   259→
   260→def _workflow_partitions(
   261→    plan: dict | None,
   262→    state: StateModel,
   263→) -> tuple[list[WorkQueueItem], list[WorkQueueItem], list[WorkQueueItem]]:
   264→    if not isinstance(plan, dict):
   265→        return [], [], []
   266→    scan_items = [
   267→        item
   268→        for item in (
   269→            build_deferred_disposition_item(plan),
   270→            build_run_scan_item(plan),
   271→        )
   272→        if item is not None
   273→    ]
   274→    postflight_workflow = [
   275→        item
   276→        for item in (
   277→            build_score_checkpoint_item(plan, state),
   278→            build_import_scores_item(plan, state),
   279→            build_communicate_score_item(plan, state),
   280→            build_create_plan_item(plan),
   281→        )
   282→        if item is not None
   283→    ]
   284→    triage_items = build_triage_stage_items(plan, state)
   285→    return scan_items, postflight_workflow, triage_items
   286→
   287→
   288→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   289→# Phase resolution — persisted fine-grained phase with legacy fallback
   290→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   291→
   292→def _raw_persisted_phase(plan: dict | None) -> str | None:
   293→    """Read the raw lifecycle_phase string from the plan, without validation."""
   294→    if not isinstance(plan, dict):
   295→        return None
   296→    refresh_state = plan.get("refresh_state")
   297→    if isinstance(refresh_state, dict):
   298→        phase = refresh_state.get("lifecycle_phase")
   299→        if isinstance(phase, str):
   300→            return phase
   301→    return None
   302→
   303→
   304→def _phase_for_snapshot(
   305→    plan: dict | None,
   306→    *,
   307→    fresh_boundary: bool,
   308→    initial_review_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   309→    anchored_execution_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   310→    explicit_queue_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   311→    scan_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   312→    review_backlog_present: bool,
   313→    undispositioned_review_backlog_present: bool,
   314→    postflight_assessment_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   315→    postflight_review_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   316→    postflight_workflow_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   317→    triage_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   318→) -> str:
   319→    raw_phase = _raw_persisted_phase(plan)
   320→
   321→    ordered_postflight_phase = _ordered_postflight_phase(
   322→        postflight_assessment_items=postflight_assessment_items,
   323→        postflight_review_items=postflight_review_items,
   324→        postflight_workflow_items=postflight_workflow_items,
   325→        triage_items=triage_items,
   326→    )
   327→
   328→    # ── Fine-grained persisted phase: trust it if items match ──
   329→    if raw_phase in {
   330→        PHASE_ASSESSMENT_POSTFLIGHT,
   331→        PHASE_REVIEW_POSTFLIGHT,
   332→        PHASE_WORKFLOW_POSTFLIGHT,
   333→        PHASE_TRIAGE_POSTFLIGHT,
   334→    } and ordered_postflight_phase is not None:
   335→        return ordered_postflight_phase
   336→    if raw_phase in _FINE_GRAINED_ITEM_MAP:
   337→        [REDACTED][raw_phase]
   338→        items = locals().get(items_key) if items_key else None
   339→        if items_key is None or items:
   340→            return raw_phase
   341→    # Execute needs special check (two possible item lists).
   342→    if raw_phase == LIFECYCLE_PHASE_EXECUTE and (anchored_execution_items or explicit_queue_items):
   343→        return PHASE_EXECUTE
   344→
   345→    # ── Legacy inference for coarse-phase or missing-phase plans ──
   346→    return _legacy_phase_inference(
   347→        plan,
   348→        fresh_boundary=fresh_boundary,
   349→        initial_review_items=initial_review_items,
   350→        anchored_execution_items=anchored_execution_items,
   351→        explicit_queue_items=explicit_queue_items,
   352→        scan_items=scan_items,
   353→        review_backlog_present=review_backlog_present,
   354→        undispositioned_review_backlog_present=undispositioned_review_backlog_present,
   355→        postflight_assessment_items=postflight_assessment_items,
   356→        postflight_review_items=postflight_review_items,
   357→        postflight_workflow_items=postflight_workflow_items,
   358→        triage_items=triage_items,
   359→    )
   360→
   361→
   362→def _ordered_postflight_phase(
   363→    *,
   364→    postflight_assessment_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   365→    postflight_review_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   366→    postflight_workflow_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   367→    triage_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   368→) -> str | None:
   369→    """Return the earliest active postflight phase in fixed sequence order."""
   370→    if postflight_assessment_items:
   371→        return PHASE_ASSESSMENT_POSTFLIGHT
   372→    if postflight_workflow_items:
   373→        return PHASE_WORKFLOW_POSTFLIGHT
   374→    if triage_items:
   375→        return PHASE_TRIAGE_POSTFLIGHT
   376→    if postflight_review_items:
   377→        return PHASE_REVIEW_POSTFLIGHT
   378→    return None
   379→
   380→
   381→def _legacy_phase_inference(
   382→    plan: dict | None,
   383→    *,
   384→    fresh_boundary: bool,
   385→    initial_review_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   386→    anchored_execution_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   387→    explicit_queue_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   388→    scan_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   389→    review_backlog_present: bool,
   390→    undispositioned_review_backlog_present: bool,
   391→    postflight_assessment_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   392→    postflight_review_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   393→    postflight_workflow_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   394→    triage_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   395→) -> str:
   396→    """Infer the phase from item partitions for plans without fine-grained phases.
   397→
   398→    This handles old plans that persisted coarse phases ("review", "workflow",
   399→    "triage") or have no persisted phase at all.  As plans are migrated to
   400→    fine-grained phases by the reconcile pipeline, this code path is exercised
   401→    less frequently.
   402→    """
   403→    persisted_phase = (
   404→        current_lifecycle_phase(plan) if isinstance(plan, dict) else None
   405→    )
   406→
   407→    # Coarse "postflight sticky" — old plans that persisted a coarse phase
   408→    # need priority-ordered inference within that phase family.
   409→    postflight_sticky = (
   410→        isinstance(plan, dict)
   411→        and persisted_phase in _COARSE_POSTFLIGHT_PHASES
   412→        and not postflight_scan_pending(plan)
   413→    )
   414→
   415→    if fresh_boundary and initial_review_items:
   416→        return PHASE_REVIEW_INITIAL
   417→
   418→    if postflight_sticky:
   419→        result = _sticky_postflight_phase(
   420→            persisted_phase,
   421→            postflight_assessment_items=postflight_assessment_items,
   422→            postflight_review_items=postflight_review_items,
   423→            postflight_workflow_items=postflight_workflow_items,
   424→            triage_items=triage_items,
   425→            review_backlog_present=review_backlog_present,
   426→        )
   427→        if result is not None:
   428→            return result
   429→
   430→    if anchored_execution_items:
   431→        return PHASE_EXECUTE
   432→    if scan_items:
   433→        return PHASE_SCAN
   434→    if explicit_queue_items and (
   435→        not isinstance(plan, dict) or postflight_scan_pending(plan)
   436→    ):
   437→        return PHASE_EXECUTE
   438→
   439→    # Postflight sequence: assessment → workflow → triage → review → execute.
   440→    if postflight_assessment_items:
   441→        return PHASE_ASSESSMENT_POSTFLIGHT
   442→    if postflight_workflow_items:
   443→        return PHASE_WORKFLOW_POSTFLIGHT
   444→    if undispositioned_review_backlog_present and postflight_review_items:
   445→        return PHASE_REVIEW_POSTFLIGHT
   446→    if explicit_queue_items:
   447→        return PHASE_EXECUTE
   448→    if postflight_review_items:
   449→        return PHASE_REVIEW_POSTFLIGHT
   450→    if triage_items:
   451→        return PHASE_TRIAGE_POSTFLIGHT
   452→    return PHASE_SCAN
   453→
   454→
   455→def _sticky_postflight_phase(
   456→    persisted_phase: str | None,
   457→    *,
   458→    postflight_assessment_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   459→    postflight_review_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   460→    postflight_workflow_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   461→    triage_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   462→    review_backlog_present: bool,
   463→) -> str | None:
   464→    """Resolve phase within a coarse postflight-sticky context.
   465→
   466→    Returns None if no items match, letting the caller fall through.
   467→    """
   468→    if persisted_phase == LIFECYCLE_PHASE_WORKFLOW:
   469→        candidates = [
   470→            (postflight_workflow_items, PHASE_WORKFLOW_POSTFLIGHT),
   471→            (triage_items, PHASE_TRIAGE_POSTFLIGHT),
   472→            (postflight_assessment_items, PHASE_ASSESSMENT_POSTFLIGHT),
   473→            (postflight_review_items, PHASE_REVIEW_POSTFLIGHT),
   474→        ]
   475→    elif persisted_phase == LIFECYCLE_PHASE_TRIAGE:
   476→        candidates = [
   477→            (triage_items, PHASE_TRIAGE_POSTFLIGHT),
   478→            (postflight_workflow_items, PHASE_WORKFLOW_POSTFLIGHT),
   479→            (postflight_assessment_items, PHASE_ASSESSMENT_POSTFLIGHT),
   480→            (postflight_review_items, PHASE_REVIEW_POSTFLIGHT),
   481→        ]
   482→    else:
   483→        # Coarse "review" phase.
   484→        candidates = [
   485→            (postflight_assessment_items, PHASE_ASSESSMENT_POSTFLIGHT),
   486→            (postflight_review_items, PHASE_REVIEW_POSTFLIGHT),
   487→            (postflight_workflow_items, PHASE_WORKFLOW_POSTFLIGHT),
   488→            (triage_items, PHASE_TRIAGE_POSTFLIGHT),
   489→        ]
   490→    for items, phase in candidates:
   491→        if items:
   492→            return phase
   493→    return None
   494→
   495→
   496→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   497→# Execution item selection
   498→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   499→
   500→def _execution_items_for_phase(
   501→    phase: str,
   502→    *,
   503→    explicit_queue_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   504→    initial_review_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   505→    scan_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   506→    postflight_assessment_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   507→    postflight_review_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   508→    postflight_workflow_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   509→    triage_items: list[WorkQueueItem],
   510→) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   511→    if phase == PHASE_REVIEW_INITIAL:
   512→        return initial_review_items
   513→    if phase == PHASE_EXECUTE:
   514→        return explicit_queue_items
   515→    if phase == PHASE_SCAN:
   516→        deferred_items = [
   517→            item for item in scan_items
   518→            if item.get("id") == WORKFLOW_DEFERRED_DISPOSITION_ID
   519→        ]
   520→        if deferred_items:
   521→            return deferred_items
   522→        return [
   523→            item for item in scan_items
   524→            if item.get("id") == WORKFLOW_RUN_SCAN_ID
   525→        ]
   526→    if phase == PHASE_ASSESSMENT_POSTFLIGHT:
   527→        return postflight_assessment_items
   528→    if phase == PHASE_REVIEW_POSTFLIGHT:
   529→        return postflight_review_items
   530→    if phase == PHASE_WORKFLOW_POSTFLIGHT:
   531→        return postflight_workflow_items
   532→    if phase == PHASE_TRIAGE_POSTFLIGHT:
   533→        return triage_items
   534→    return []
   535→
   536→
   537→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   538→# Item partition building
   539→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   540→
   541→class _Partitions(NamedTuple):
   542→    """All item lists computed from state + plan, before phase resolution."""
   543→
   544→    objective_items: list[WorkQueueItem]
   545→    explicit_objective_items: list[WorkQueueItem]
   546→    review_issue_items: list[WorkQueueItem]
   547→    initial_review_items: list[WorkQueueItem]
   548→    subjective_postflight_items: list[WorkQueueItem]
   549→    postflight_assessment_items: list[WorkQueueItem]
   550→    postflight_review_items: list[WorkQueueItem]
   551→    scan_items: list[WorkQueueItem]
   552→    postflight_workflow_items: list[WorkQueueItem]
   553→    triage_items: list[WorkQueueItem]
   554→    explicit_queue_items: list[WorkQueueItem]
   555→    anchored_execution_items: list[WorkQueueItem]
   556→
   557→
   558→def _build_item_partitions(
   559→    state: StateModel,
   560→    *,
   561→    effective_plan: dict | None,
   562→    scan_path: str | None,
   563→    scope: object | None,
   564→    chronic: bool,
   565→    target_strict: float,
   566→) -> _Partitions:
   567→    """Build all item partitions from state and plan."""
   568→    skipped_ids = set((effective_plan or {}).get("skipped", {}).keys())
   569→    scoped_issues = path_scoped_issues(
   570→        (state.get("work_items") or state.get("issues", {})), scan_path,
   571→    )
   572→
   573→    all_issue_items = build_issue_items(
   574→        state,
   575→        scan_path=scan_path,
   576→        status_filter="open",
   577→        scope=scope,
   578→        chronic=chronic,
   579→        forced_ids=_live_planned_queue_ids(effective_plan),
   580→    )
   581→    objective_items = [
   582→        item for item in all_issue_items
   583→        if _is_objective_item(item, skipped_ids=skipped_ids)
   584→    ]
   585→    executable_objective_ids = _executable_objective_ids(
   586→        {item.get("id", "") for item in objective_items},
   587→        effective_plan,
   588→    )
   589→    all_clustered_ids = _all_cluster_issue_ids(effective_plan)
   590→    if (
   591→        isinstance(effective_plan, dict)
   592→        and not _live_planned_queue_ids(effective_plan)
   593→        and all_clustered_ids & executable_objective_ids
   594→    ):
   595→        executable_objective_ids -= all_clustered_ids
   596→    explicit_objective_items = [
   597→        item for item in objective_items
   598→        if item.get("id", "") in executable_objective_ids
   599→    ]
   600→
   601→    review_issue_items = _review_issue_items(all_issue_items)
   602→    assessment_request_items_list = _assessment_request_items(all_issue_items)
   603→    executable_review_items = _executable_review_issue_items(
   604→        effective_plan, state, review_issue_items,
   605→    )
   606→    review_issue_ids = {item.get("id", "") for item in review_issue_items}
   607→    assessment_request_ids = {item.get("id", "") for item in assessment_request_items_list}
   608→
   609→    explicit_queue_items, anchored_execution_items = _merge_execution_candidates(
   610→        all_issue_items=all_issue_items,
   611→        explicit_objective_items=explicit_objective_items,
   612→        plan=effective_plan,
   613→        review_issue_ids=review_issue_ids,
   614→        assessment_request_ids=assessment_request_ids,
   615→    )
   616→
   617→    initial_review_items, subjective_postflight_items = _subjective_partitions(
   618→        state, scoped_issues=scoped_issues, threshold=target_strict, plan=effective_plan,
   619→    )
   620→    # Suppress subjective dimension items when review issues already cover
   621→    # the same dimension — the review issues are more actionable.
   622→    postflight_assessment_items = [
   623→        item
   624→        for item in subjective_postflight_items
   625→        if not (
   626→            item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension"
   627→            and int((item.get("detail") or {}).get("open_review_issues", 0)) > 0
   628→        )
   629→    ] + list(assessment_request_items_list)
   630→    postflight_review_items = list(executable_review_items)
   631→
   632→    scan_items, postflight_workflow_items, triage_items = _workflow_partitions(
   633→        effective_plan, state,
   634→    )
   635→
   636→    return _Partitions(
   637→        objective_items=objective_items,
   638→        explicit_objective_items=explicit_objective_items,
   639→        review_issue_items=review_issue_items,
   640→        initial_review_items=initial_review_items,
   641→        subjective_postflight_items=subjective_postflight_items,
   642→        postflight_assessment_items=postflight_assessment_items,
   643→        postflight_review_items=postflight_review_items,
   644→        scan_items=scan_items,
   645→        postflight_workflow_items=postflight_workflow_items,
   646→        triage_items=triage_items,
   647→        explicit_queue_items=explicit_queue_items,
   648→        anchored_execution_items=anchored_execution_items,
   649→    )
   650→
   651→
   652→def _build_backlog(
   653→    p: _Partitions,
   654→    execution_ids: set[str],
   655→) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   656→    return [
   657→        item for item in (
   658→            [
   659→                *p.objective_items,
   660→                *p.initial_review_items,
   661→                *p.postflight_assessment_items,
   662→                *p.review_issue_items,
   663→                *p.scan_items,
   664→                *p.postflight_workflow_items,
   665→                *p.triage_items,
   666→            ]
   667→        )
   668→        if item.get("id", "") not in execution_ids
   669→    ]
   670→
   671→
   672→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   673→# Public API
   674→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   675→
   676→def build_queue_snapshot(
   677→    state: StateModel,
   678→    *,
   679→    options: object | None = None,
   680→    plan: dict | None = None,
   681→    target_strict: float = DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE,
   682→) -> QueueSnapshot:
   683→    """Build the canonical queue snapshot for the current state."""
   684→    context = _option_value(options, "context", None)
   685→    effective_plan = context.plan if context is not None else (
   686→        plan if plan is not None else _option_value(options, "plan", None)
   687→    )
   688→
   689→    p = _build_item_partitions(
   690→        state,
   691→        effective_plan=effective_plan,
   692→        scan_path=_resolved_scan_path(options, state),
   693→        scope=_option_value(options, "scope", None),
   694→        chronic=bool(_option_value(options, "chronic", False)),
   695→        target_strict=target_strict,
   696→    )
   697→
   698→    triage_snapshot = (
   699→        build_triage_snapshot(effective_plan, state)
   700→        if isinstance(effective_plan, dict)
   701→        else None
   702→    )
   703→    fresh_boundary = _is_fresh_boundary(effective_plan)
   704→
   705→    phase = _phase_for_snapshot(
   706→        effective_plan,
   707→        fresh_boundary=fresh_boundary,
   708→        initial_review_items=p.initial_review_items,
   709→        anchored_execution_items=p.anchored_execution_items,
   710→        explicit_queue_items=p.explicit_queue_items,
   711→        scan_items=p.scan_items,
   712→        review_backlog_present=bool(p.review_issue_items),
   713→        undispositioned_review_backlog_present=bool(
   714→            triage_snapshot is not None and triage_snapshot.undispositioned_ids
   715→        ),
   716→        postflight_assessment_items=p.postflight_assessment_items,
   717→        postflight_review_items=p.postflight_review_items,
   718→        postflight_workflow_items=p.postflight_workflow_items,
   719→        triage_items=p.triage_items,
   720→    )
   721→    execution_items = _execution_items_for_phase(
   722→        phase,
   723→        explicit_queue_items=p.explicit_queue_items,
   724→        initial_review_items=p.initial_review_items,
   725→        scan_items=p.scan_items,
   726→        postflight_assessment_items=p.postflight_assessment_items,
   727→        postflight_review_items=p.postflight_review_items,
   728→        postflight_workflow_items=p.postflight_workflow_items,
   729→        triage_items=p.triage_items,
   730→    )
   731→
   732→    execution_ids = {item.get("id", "") for item in execution_items}
   733→    backlog_items = _build_backlog(p, execution_ids)
   734→    objective_backlog_count = sum(
   735→        1 for item in p.objective_items if item.get("id", "") not in execution_ids
   736→    )
   737→
   738→    return QueueSnapshot(
   739→        phase=phase,
   740→        all_objective_items=tuple(p.objective_items),
   741→        all_initial_review_items=tuple(p.initial_review_items),
   742→        all_postflight_assessment_items=tuple(p.postflight_assessment_items),
   743→        all_postflight_review_items=tuple(p.postflight_review_items),
   744→        all_scan_items=tuple(p.scan_items),
   745→        all_postflight_workflow_items=tuple(p.postflight_workflow_items),
   746→        all_postflight_triage_items=tuple(p.triage_items),
   747→        execution_items=tuple(execution_items),
   748→        backlog_items=tuple(backlog_items),
   749→        objective_in_scope_count=len(p.objective_items),
   750→        planned_objective_count=len(p.explicit_objective_items),
   751→        objective_execution_count=sum(
   752→            1
   753→            for item in execution_items
   754→            if item.get("kind") in {"issue", "cluster"}
   755→            and counts_toward_objective_backlog(item)
   756→        ),
   757→        objective_backlog_count=objective_backlog_count,
   758→        subjective_initial_count=len(p.initial_review_items),
   759→        assessment_postflight_count=len(p.postflight_assessment_items),
   760→        subjective_postflight_count=len(p.subjective_postflight_items),
   761→        workflow_postflight_count=len(p.postflight_workflow_items),
   762→        triage_pending_count=len(p.triage_items),
   763→        has_unplanned_objective_blockers=len(p.explicit_objective_items) < len(p.objective_items),
   764→    )
   765→
   766→
   767→__all__ = [
   768→    "PHASE_ASSESSMENT_POSTFLIGHT",
   769→    "PHASE_EXECUTE",
   770→    "PHASE_REVIEW_INITIAL",
